qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When the siren sounds, passengers will please make their way to the assembly point without delay. [G = Come quickly.]
1. Would staff please remain at their desks today until midday while preparations for the IT system intensive monitoring check are being made.
2. Please give all of the material a very intensive examination: if we make a mistake at this point, this is what people will remember us for until the end of time.
3. In appearance, these two spiders are remarkably similar; caution is required, as a mistake in handling could prove to be a memorable experience.
4. You must keep in mind that someone has to look after grandma this weekend. Her care schedule is not difficult, and she mustn't leave the house!
5. This examination is very important and the outcome is going to remain with you for the rest of your life so make sure your preparation is thorough.
items: 1 — Staff please remain at desks until midday during the IT monitoring check.
2 — Give all material a very intensive examination — a mistake now will define us.
3 — These two spiders are similar; caution is required in handling them.
4 — Someone has to look after grandma this weekend. She mustn't leave the house!
5 — This examination is very important. Make sure your preparation is thorough.

pairs.l: 1 — Staff please remain at desks until midday during the IT monitoring check.
2 — Give all material a very intensive examination — a mistake now will define us.
3 — These two spiders are similar; caution is required in handling them.
4 — Someone has to look after grandma this weekend. She mustn't leave the house!
5 — This examination is very important. Make sure your preparation is thorough.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (ostanite za stolovima do podne) = C (Stay there). Poruka 2 (pažljivo pregledajte sve materijale) = F (Look closely). Poruka 3 (oprez pri rukovanju sličnim paucima) = E (Watch out). Poruka 4 (ne zaboraviti brinuti o baki) = A (Don't forget). Poruka 5 (ispitivanje je važno, dobro se pripremi) = B (Get ready).

qs.q:
Where is Tara going to spend her weekend?

"Despite my original plan to stay with you this weekend, I'll be away, writing that essay on my own. Mum and I have two days to clean grandma's beach house, which is a bore, but the fresh air will surely do me good."

A At home.
B At the seaside.
C At Jemma's house.
qs.exp: 'Two days to clean grandma's BEACH HOUSE' = vikend uz more = B (At the seaside).

qs.q:
How does Jim feel about the video game?

"I spent the entire evening yesterday checking out that game you recommended. I can't understand how anyone could say it isn't fun. It might not be easy for inexperienced players to master since it's quite complex, but I just had a blast. Thanks!"

A It's entertaining.
B It's difficult.
C It's boring.
qs.exp: 'I just had a BLAST' = zabavio sam se odlično = A (It's entertaining). Kompleksna je, ali zabavna.

qs.q:
How is Manny going to travel to work tomorrow?

"Thanks for offering to give me a lift tomorrow, but it turns out my boss wants me to get to work an hour earlier. The bus would be the most comfortable option for me since I don't like being underground, but the tube station is the closest to my house, so I'll go for that."

A By car.
B By bus.
C By train.
qs.exp: 'The TUBE station is the closest to my house, so I'll go for that' → podzemna željeznica = C (By train / tube).

qs.q:
Why isn't Donna going to the party?

"Now that I've finally convinced my mother to let me go to that party by promising to improve my grades, my temperature has shot up! Can you believe it? There's no way it'll go away by tomorrow night, so you'll have to go without me."

A She isn't allowed to.
B She isn't feeling well.
C She has to do her homework.
opts: She has to do her homework.
qs.exp: 'My temperature has shot up' = porasla joj je temperatura → bolest = B (She isn't feeling well).

qs.q:
What is Susanna getting for her birthday?

"We've been browsing an online jewellery shop to find a gift for Susanna's birthday and they have both necklaces and bracelets that match the earrings she received from her boyfriend. The necklace is a bit more expensive, but we remembered how she once mentioned that she didn't like wearing anything around her wrists, which made our decision easier."

A A necklace.
B A bracelet.
C Earrings.
qs.exp: 'Didn't like wearing anything around her WRISTS' (narukvice) → kupuju ogrlicu = A (A necklace).

qs.q:
The Silent Hero

"Best known for his iconic stage persona 'Bip the Clown', whose name is based on Pip, a character from Dickens' novel 'Great Expectations'."

Who was 'Bip the Clown'?
A A character from a novel.
B A cartoon character.
C A mime character.
qs.exp: Bip je Marceauov scenski alter ego, mimičar (mime character) = C. Pip je lik iz romana, ali Bip je Marceauov scenski lik.

qs.q:
The Silent Hero

"Marceau was recruited by his cousin, Georges Loinger, the commander of a secret Jewish relief group that smuggled Jewish children from occupied France to neutral countries."

What did Marcel do thanks to his cousin?
A He changed his name.
B He joined the French Resistance.
C He became the leader of the Resistance.
opts: He became the leader of the Resistance.
qs.exp: 'Marceau was RECRUITED by his cousin' → pridružio se Otporu zahvaljujući bratiću = B.

qs.q:
The Silent Hero

"The group's mission was to evacuate Jewish children hidden in a French orphanage and get them to the Swiss border, where they would find safety."

What was the purpose of the Jewish relief group?
A To transport children to a safe place.
B To take a group of children on holiday.
C To hide children in a French orphanage.
opts: To transport children to a safe place.
To take a group of children on holiday.
To hide children in a French orphanage.
qs.exp: 'Evacuate children... get them to the Swiss border, where they would FIND SAFETY' = odvesti djecu na sigurno = A.

qs.q:
The Silent Hero

"Once he disguised himself as a boy scout leader and took 24 Jewish kids in scout uniforms through the forests to the border. When he unexpectedly ran into a group of German soldiers, he pretended that he was a member of the French Army and convinced all 30 of them to surrender."

How did Marcel avoid being killed by a group of German soldiers?
A By pretending to be a French soldier.
B By wearing a boy scout uniform.
C By surrendering to them.
opts: By pretending to be a French soldier.
By wearing a boy scout uniform.
qs.exp: 'He PRETENDED that he was a member of the French Army and convinced all 30 to SURRENDER' → pretvario se da je francuski vojnik = A.

qs.q:
The Silent Hero

"The silent hero soon skyrocketed to worldwide fame, thanks to the universality of his expression. As he said – mime, like music, knows neither borders nor nationalities."

Why did audiences across the world love Marcel's performances?
A Because of the music he played.
B Because everyone would do them.
C Because everyone could understand them.
opts: Because of the music he played.
qs.exp: 'Thanks to the UNIVERSALITY of his expression... knows neither borders nor nationalities' → razumljivo svima = C.

qs.q:
Generation Alpha

"Daily life has become more digital than ever before, (16) ____ – comfortable with changing technologies from an early age."

A which allows for a personalised academic experience
B as they find themselves at the beginning of a new era
C despite the fact that the old system is crumbling down
D they will likely face serious challenges
E which makes them true digital natives
F they are the product of a universal upbringing
G are kids destined to shape the future in unique ways
opts: A — which allows for a personalised academic experience
B — as they find themselves at the beginning of a new era
C — despite the fact that the old system is crumbling down
D — they will likely face serious challenges
E — which makes them true digital natives
F — they are the product of a universal upbringing
G — are kids destined to shape the future
qs.exp: 'Daily life more digital, (16)____ – comfortable with changing technologies from early age.' → E: which makes them true digital natives. Digitalni urođenici.

Generation Alpha

"Thanks to global connectivity, (17) ____." 

A which allows for a personalised academic experience
B as they find themselves at the beginning of a new era
C despite the fact that the old system is crumbling down
D they will likely face serious challenges
E which makes them true digital natives
F they are the product of a universal upbringing

opts: A — which allows for a personalised academic experience

qs.q:
Fairy Tales as Old as Time

"...they were listening to or reading stories written down by one of (21) ___ three most famous authors of fairy tales – the Brothers Grimm, Hans Christian Andersen or Charles Perrault."

A a
B the
C Ø
qs.exp: 'One of THE three most famous authors' — određeni član 'the' uz superlativne/ograničene skupove.

qs.q:
Fairy Tales as Old as Time

"There are also other authors and sources of stories, depending (22) ___ where in the world you were born."

A on
B of
C by
qs.exp: 'Depending ON where in the world you were born' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: depend on.

qs.q:
Fairy Tales as Old as Time

"A recent study, (23) ____, has found that the sources behind these stories date back further than the 16th century."

A but
B although
C however
qs.exp: 'A recent study, HOWEVER, has found...' — diskurzivni prilog 'however' između zareza koji uvodi neočekivano otkriće.

qs.q:
Fairy Tales as Old as Time

"Most of the stories we base our fairy tales on are (24) ___ 4,000 and 5,000 years old."

A about
B around
C between
qs.exp: 'BETWEEN 4,000 and 5,000 years old' — 'between... and...' za raspon između dva broja.

qs.q:
Fairy Tales as Old as Time

"Researchers have managed to trace a story called 'The Smith and the Devil' to as far back as 6,000 years (25) ___."

A long
B ago
C before
qs.exp: '6,000 years AGO' — prilog 'ago' za vremenski period u prošlosti od sadašnjosti.

qs.q:
Harriet Tubman

"Fearing being sold to another owner in the deep South, (26) ___ the age of 29 she fled to Philadelphia."

A in
B to
C what
D can
E at
F which
G where
H would
I it
qs.exp: 'AT the age of 29 she fled' — prijedlog 'at' uz dob: at the age of.

qs.q:
Harriet Tubman

"She made twelve more trips, along (27) ___ was known as the 'Underground Railroad'."

A in
B to
C what
D can
E at
F which
G where
H would
I it
qs.exp: 'Along WHAT was known as the Underground Railroad' — relativna zamjenica 'what' (= that which) u prepozicijskoj frazi.

qs.q:
Harriet Tubman

"A network of people who (28) ___ shelter escaping slaves."

A in
B to
C what
D can
E at
F which
G where
H would
I it
qs.exp: 'People who WOULD give shelter escaping slaves' — 'would' za tipičnu prošlu radnju/naviku: would = used to.

qs.q:
Harriet Tubman

"She settled 70 enslaved people (29) ___ Canada."

A in
B to
C what
D can
E at
F which
G where
H would
I it
qs.exp: 'Settled people IN Canada' — prijedlog 'in' uz ime zemlje gdje su se nastanili.

qs.q:
Harriet Tubman

"Tubman lived on her farm, (30) ___ was a refuge for elderly people and orphans."

A in
B to
C what
D can
E at
F which
G where
H would
I it
qs.exp: 'Lived on her farm, WHICH was a refuge' — relativna zamjenica 'which' za ne-restriktivnu surečenicu (uz zarez, odnosi se na farmu).

qs.q:
Read the message from Ella:

"Hi!
I'm going to take the Spanish course in September, and I'm wondering how you're getting on with your language course.
What are your impressions after your first semester?
What aspects of the course did you like best and why?
What methods of learning would you advise and why?
Ella"

Write Ella a reply. Answer all her questions. Write 80–100 words.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) dojmovi nakon prvog semestra, (2) koji dio tečaja ti se najviše svidio i zašto, (3) koje metode učenja preporučuješ i zašto. Dužina 80–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (80–100 riječi).

qs.q:
You will hear five voice messages.
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

A — I'll make it.
B — Try again.
C — Pick me up.
D — Come over.
E — Hurry up.
F — It's not allowed.
qs.exp: Prema službenom ključu: 1=C, 2=A, 3=F, 4=E, 5=B.

qs.q:
You hear a patient making an appointment at the doctor's office.
What is the patient's surname?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q6 = B (Nguyen).

qs.q:
You hear a boy talking about his upcoming maths exam.
How does he feel about it?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q7 = A (Worried / zabrinut).

qs.q:
You hear a student talking about going to the seaside.
What is her main reason for going there?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q8 = B (Employment / posao).

qs.q:
You hear a man discussing the finding of a survey.
What proportion of the people surveyed would buy the organic selection again?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q9 = A (50%).

qs.q:
You hear a woman talking about her garden.
What is her favourite flower?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q10 = C (The daisy / tratinčica).

qs.q:
You hear a radio interview with Janine Sutton about her floating restaurant.

Why did Janine start the floating restaurant?
opts: She was bored of working in a bank.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q11 = C (She inherited a boat).

qs.q: Who are Janine's customers, for the most part?
opts: People who want a new experience.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q12 = A (Regular clients / stalni gosti).

qs.q: What is the most difficult part of Janine's job?
opts: Making sure the menu has variety.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q13 = B (Managing the finances).

qs.q: What is the hardest part of daily management?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q14 = C (Checking there are enough ingredients).

qs.q: What are Janine's plans for the future?
opts: To keep things as they are.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q15 = C (To keep things as they are).

qs.q:
You hear a speaker talking about 'Sunny Lingua', a language learning app.

How do learners start using the 'Sunny Lingua' app?
opts: By learning to describe their family.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q16 = C (By learning to describe their family).

qs.q: What's the best way for beginners to start learning a language?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q17 = C (Choose your own learning method).

qs.q: How much daily practice does the speaker recommend?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q18 = A (15 minutes).

qs.q: What does the app help users do best?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q19 = C (Join in conversations).

qs.q: What makes the app stand out?
opts: It helps you produce elegant phrases.
It connects you with other students.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q20 = B (It generates a vocabulary list).

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. I'm afraid you'll get angry with me, but I have to tell you what happened. I've broken your new iPad, and I can't afford to have it fixed. I feel terrible.
2. We all know that you had good intentions, but we all make mistakes sometimes. Just apologise sincerely, explain yourself, learn from it and move on. Beating yourself up won't help anyone.
3. The tea is in the pot, and there's plenty of fruit in the fridge. Stay in bed and take both aspirins and vitamins regularly. You should feel better soon.
4. Handling this machine is a bit risky and should be done properly, so read the instructions carefully and make sure everybody listens and wears all the protective gear that came in the package.
5. Moving out of your comfort zone will require a bit of courage and confidence. Life is sometimes scary, but playing it safe is not how you achieve great things.
items: 1 — I've broken your new iPad. I can't afford to have it fixed. I feel terrible.
2 — We all make mistakes. Just apologise, learn from it and move on.
3 — Stay in bed and take aspirins and vitamins regularly. You should feel better soon.
4 — Handling this machine is risky. Read the instructions and wear all protective gear.
5 — Moving out of your comfort zone requires courage. Playing it safe is not how you achieve great things.

pairs.l: 1 — I've broken your new iPad. I can't afford to have it fixed. I feel terrible.
2 — We all make mistakes. Just apologise, learn from it and move on.
3 — Stay in bed and take aspirins and vitamins regularly. You should feel better soon.
4 — Handling this machine is risky. Read the instructions and wear all protective gear.
5 — Moving out of your comfort zone requires courage. Playing it safe is not how you achieve great things.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (slomio/la je iPad, osjeća se strašno) = E (I am so sorry). Poruka 2 (svi griješimo, ne muči se) = A (Don't feel bad). Poruka 3 (ostani u krevetu, pij aspirin) = F (Take care of yourself). Poruka 4 (pazi s mašinom, nosi opremu) = B (Be careful). Poruka 5 (izađi iz zone komfora, preuzmi rizik) = D (Take the risk).

qs.q:
Where is Zayn having his party?

"Thanks for inviting me to your party on Saturday. I was just wondering how to get there since I've never been. Is it far away from the city centre, where we usually meet before we go out? I'm coming directly after a birthday party held at my family's restaurant, so someone can drive me to your place."

A At the family restaurant.
B In the city centre.
C At his home.
qs.exp: 'Someone can drive me to YOUR PLACE' → Zaynova zabava je kod njega doma = C (At his home).

qs.q:
How much time will Selena and Taylor spend getting to the concert?

"I have a curfew and need to be home by 11 pm. Instead of walking there and back home, which could take us ninety minutes, I've asked my dad to drive us. So we'll only need an hour to get to and from the concert."

A Thirty minutes.
B Sixty minutes.
C Ninety minutes.
qs.exp: 'An hour to get TO AND FROM' = sat ukupno, dakle 30 minuta za dolazak (A = Thirty minutes).

qs.q:
What did Hailey think of the film?

"Although the online critics rated it very poorly and described it as dull, I remembered that you found it entertaining. Since we usually like similar films, I thought it would be at least action-packed. After watching it, I think I'll have to side with the critics this time."

A It was boring.
B It was amusing.
C It was dramatic.
qs.exp: 'Side with the critics' koji su rekli 'dull' = dosadan → Hailey je zaključila da je film bio dosadan = A (boring).

qs.q:
What time will Charli start warming up at school before the try-outs?

"The try-outs for the basketball team start tomorrow at 9 o'clock. The coach said we should be there any time from 8.15 to warm up. I'll be there about a quarter of an hour before the start since I'm walking to school."

A At 8.15.
B At 8.45.
C At 9.00.
qs.exp: Početak u 9:00, Charli dolazi 15 minuta ranije → 9:00 − 0:15 = 8:45 (B).

qs.q:
Why are Loren and Zach going on their road trip?

"I wanted to ask you if we could make a little detour on Friday and stop in Reading to see my family there. It's not that far from Oxford and our scheduled university tour doesn't start until Saturday at 1 pm. On our way back on Sunday, we could also stop at that designer outlet centre in Swindon."

A To visit Loren's family in Reading.
B To do some shopping in Swindon.
C To look around a university in Oxford.
opts: To visit Loren's family in Reading.
To do some shopping in Swindon.
To look around a university in Oxford.
qs.exp: Glavni razlog putovanja je 'university tour' u Oxfordu (u subotu) → C (To look around a university in Oxford).

qs.q:
Heyside Hall

"It was ordered by Sir Nathaniel Curran-Jones as a wedding gift at the request of his fiancée Penelope on his return from India in 1826. Completed five years after the marriage ceremony in 1831..."

In what year was the construction of Heyside Hall finished?
A 1826.
B 1831.
C 1836.
qs.exp: Naručeno 1826., završeno 5 godina NAKON vjenčanja 1831. → 1831 + 5 = 1836 = C.

qs.q:
Heyside Hall

"Completed five years after the marriage ceremony in 1831, the hall was designed by the famous architect David Welby. Construction was carried out by John Platt and overseen by Sir Nathaniel's best friend Tom Smith."

Who performed the building work?
A John Platt.
B Tom Smith.
C David Welby.
qs.exp: 'Construction was CARRIED OUT by John Platt' = gradnju je izveo John Platt = A.

qs.q:
Heyside Hall

"The large town of Baschester is quickly reached by the main London to Ipswich road, the journey taking half an hour by bus. However, the market towns of Epwick and Bailden are closer: the first ten minutes away and the second about twenty."

What is the nearest town to Heyside Hall?
A Epwick.
B Bailden.
C Baschester.
qs.exp: Epwick je 'the first' = 10 minuta, Bailden je 'the second' = 20 minuta → Epwick je najbliži = A.

qs.q:
Heyside Hall

"Most big houses in this part of the county are built in the neo-Classical style. On the other hand, many of those built after Georgian times, such as Heyside Hall, show the neo-Gothic style popular in the country at the time."

In what style of architecture is Heyside Hall built?
A Georgian.
B Neo-Gothic.
C Neo-Classical.
qs.exp: 'Heyside Hall shows the NEO-GOTHIC style' = B.

qs.q:
Heyside Hall

"It is said that the youthful George III calculated the exact number to be 550. Sir Nathaniel supposedly commanded David Welby to go over that total, and with twenty more windows (some impossible to clean!), Heyside Hall broke the record."

How many windows does Heyside Hall have?
A 550.
B 570.
C 590.
qs.exp: George III izbrojao 550 (Longside Palace), Heyside ima 20 više → 550 + 20 = 570 = B.

qs.q:
Digital Nomads

"Digital nomads are remote workers (0→G). They're able to (16) ____, seeing incredible places and learning from different cultures – true freedom."

A that they have with their peers
B they will have such a possibility
C to work in different places
D why they would choose such a lifestyle
E remote work has become a reality
F work when and where they want to
G who travel to different locations on a regular basis

B — they will have such a possibility
C — to work in different places
D — why they would choose such a lifestyle
E — remote work has become a reality
F — work when and where they want to
G — who travel to different locations on a regular basis
qs.exp: 'They're able to (16)____, seeing incredible places' → F: work when and where they want to. Sloboda rada = pravo mjesto i pravo vrijeme.

qs.q:
Digital Nomads

"As a result of the recent pandemic, (17) ____, so there are many opportunities for website designers, writers..."

B they will have such a possibility
C to work in different places
D why they would choose such a lifestyle
E remote work has become a reality
F work when and where they want to
G who travel to different locations on a regular basis
opts: A — that they have with their peers
B — they will have such a possibility
C — to work in different places
D — why they would choose such a lifestyle
E — remote work has become a reality
F — work when and where they want to
G — who travel to different locations on a regular basis
qs.exp: 'As a result of the pandemic, (17)____' → E: remote work has become a reality. Pandemija je ubrzala prihvaćanje rada na daljinu.

qs.q:
Digital Nomads

"They use modern technology (18) ____. These are coffee shops, hotels, co-working spaces, or libraries with a WiFi-connected laptop."

A that they have with their peers
B they will have such a possibility
C to work in different places
D why they would choose such a lifestyle
E remote work has become a reality
F work when and where they want to
G who travel to different locations on a regular basis
opts: A — that they have with their peers
B — they will have such a possibility

3 — If you'd thought carefully, you wouldn't be in this position. Just accept it.
4 — It's a tough choice but I can't wait for your response any longer.
5 — It couldn't be prevented. You can get over it. Time fixes everything.
rights: A — You need to make up your mind.
B — It's time to face the consequences.
C — You can leave this decision to me.
D — Things will work out for you eventually.

pairs.r: F — Think twice before you make your next move.

1. Don't forget to stop at the grocery. There's no point in having friends over if you have nothing to put in front of them.

items: 1 — Don't forget to stop at the grocery. Friends are coming over.
2 — Found amazing phone online. How can I convince mum the Internet is safe?
3 — I should've answered sooner. Call me on my cell phone. My bad.
4 — I lost my phone charger. Parents can't find out. Keep it secret!
5 — You and Mark must make up before the wedding this Saturday.

pairs.l: 1 — Don't forget to stop at the grocery. Friends are coming over.
2 — Found amazing phone online. How can I convince mum the Internet is safe?
3 — I should've answered sooner. Call me on my cell phone. My bad.

qs.exp: “More than a hundred thousand” = više od sto tisuća. Komparativ + ‘than’.

qs.q: No wonder ___ took 15 years for the 20,000 workers to complete the park.
qs.exp: Bezlična rečenica s formalnim subjektom: “it took 15 years” = trebalo je 15 godina.

qs.q: After opening in 1857, it ___ once became extremely popular.
qs.exp: “At once” = odmah, istog trena. Fiksna fraza.

qs.q: ...to create a place ___ people from both upper and lower classes could meet and relax.
qs.exp: Relativna rečenica za mjesto: “a place where people could meet” = mjesto gdje su se mogli sastati.

qs.q:
Read Bob’s message:

“I went on a school trip last week. Where did you go for your last school trip and why there? What did you do? What was the best bit for you?”

Write Bob a reply. Answer ALL his questions. Write 50–70 words.

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor mora: (1) navesti kamo je učenik išao na izlet i zašto, (2) opisati što su radili, (3) opisati najljepši dio. 50–70 riječi, neformalan ton.

Message 2

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. I've never seen such an extraordinary play. The actors contributed to the exceptional atmosphere. Everyone cheered with joy. [G = You should experience it.]
1. We headed towards Maksimir and realised we'd left the oven on. I know it's on your way from work, so please help out!
2. There's a new notice on the office board. It's very important that we understand the suggested changes. Don't forget to check it out tomorrow.
3. I tried to reach you by phone last week but I couldn't get through. You were unavailable. I'd like to hear from you.
4. Please do your homework before going to the book club, because you'll either be too tired or you'll forget about it.
5. It's been a while since you travelled. And dreaming big like studying in Australia is not far-fetched. I believe in you.
items: 1 — We left the oven on. It's on your way from work, so please help out!
2 — There's a new notice on the board. Don't forget to check it out tomorrow.
3 — I tried to reach you by phone but couldn't get through. I'd like to hear from you.
4 — Do your homework before going to the book club or you'll forget.
5 — Dreaming big like studying in Australia is not far-fetched. I believe in you.

pairs.l: 1 — We left the oven on. It's on your way from work, so please help out!
2 — There's a new notice on the board. Don't forget to check it out tomorrow.
3 — I tried to reach you by phone but couldn't get through. I'd like to hear from you.
4 — Do your homework before going to the book club or you'll forget.
5 — Dreaming big like studying in Australia is not far-fetched. I believe in you.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (zaboravili ostavili pećnicu upaljenbu — ugasi je) = D (Turn it off). Poruka 2 (pročitaj obavijest na ploči) = C (Read it). Poruka 3 (nisam te mogao dobiti — javi mi se) = A (Contact me). Poruka 4 (napravi domaću zadaću odmah, ne odgađaj) = B (Don't put it off). Poruka 5 (studiranje u Australiji — vjerujem u tebe, probaj) = F (Go for it).

qs.q:
Why is Gemma not attending the course during the holidays?

"I forgot to mention I'm flying to the Isle of Wight next month for a certified course in Graphic Design. I wanted to attend it last month but I was late, it was fully booked. I know it would be best to wait until the holidays, when it's cheaper, but you know me, I'm so impatient!"

A Because it was sold out.
B Because it was cheaper.
C Because she couldn't wait.
qs.exp: 'You know me, I'm so IMPATIENT!' = ne može čekati = C (Because she couldn't wait).

qs.q:
How many passengers arrived including Bella at the final stop?

"There was a blizzard and the train was delayed. First I was stuck in a carriage with a dozen other passengers and it was really stuffy, even when four of them got off and took the coach. When we started again, an elderly couple got on at the next stop and we were squeezed until we arrived at our destination."

A Four.
B Eleven.
C Twelve.
qs.exp: Bella + 12 = 13 putnika. 4 su izašla (ostalo 9). Ušao je par starijih (2) → 9 + 2 = 11 na kraju (B).

qs.q:
What did Lisa like about the exhibition?

"I loved the exhibition. What I liked was how many artists in the exhibition were exploring their dreams. They finally moved away from painting mythological scenes. The use of colour and non-traditional materials was absolutely brilliant. There was some confusion though about how the exhibits were displayed."

A It wasn't traditional.
B It was well-organised.
C It exhibited mythological themes.
qs.exp: 'Moved away from painting mythological scenes... non-traditional materials' → svidjelo joj se što nije bilo tradicionalno = A.

qs.q:
What did Monica think of the concert?

"The Choones were amazing. Despite not having a solid voice, the singer appeared pretty sure of himself. He put on quite a show. I used to think their songs weren't catchy or romantic enough and preferred more soothing music like Colday. My sister changed my mind."

A She prefers a different kind of music.
B The singer's voice was disappointing.
C The singer's performance was impressive.
opts: She prefers a different kind of music.
qs.exp: 'He PUT ON QUITE A SHOW' → nastup pjevača je bio impresivan (C). Glas nije bio jak, ali sve ostalo je bilo odlično.

qs.q:
What does Lara say about the cost of the dinner?

"The fish was absolutely mouth-watering. As for the price, it was reasonable, considering the exotic ingredients the master chef miraculously blended. We hoped it would be a bargain, since we know the restaurant owner, but we didn't mind."

A It was a bargain.
B It was expensive.
C It was medium-priced.
qs.exp: 'Reasonable' = razumna cijena, ni jeftina (bargain) ni skupa = C (medium-priced). Nadali su se popustu ali nisu dobili, ipak im nije smetalo.

qs.q:
Reading aloud

"While fewer children start reading in preschool with the help of their teachers, the majority begin reading on their own very easily as a result of their parents reading to them."

Who helps most children start reading independently?
A They themselves.
B Their teachers.
C Their parents.
qs.exp: 'The majority begin reading on their own... as a result of their PARENTS reading to them' → roditelji = C.

qs.q:
Reading aloud

"For reading aloud to be truly beneficial to children, the chosen stories must be interesting, realistic and inspiring for them."

What makes reading aloud helpful for children?
A Stories that are important to them.
B Stories that are motivating.
C Stories that are simple.
opts: Stories that are important to them.
qs.exp: 'Interesting, realistic and INSPIRING' → inspiring = motivirajuće = B (Stories that are motivating).

qs.q:
Reading aloud

"Young children often struggle with concepts that are symbolic or abstract, such as those found in fantasy novels... Complex sentences and length can also sometimes be issues."

What do young readers find most challenging?
A Abstraction.
B Long stories.
C Language structures.
qs.exp: 'Struggle with concepts that are SYMBOLIC OR ABSTRACT' → apstraktnost je najtežja = A.

qs.q:
Reading aloud

"Puzzled by unfamiliar words, children will push themselves to learn because the words are important to the story."

How do children react when they first hear a new word?
A They ignore it.
B They feel confused.
C They are discouraged.
qs.exp: 'PUZZLED by unfamiliar words' = zbunjeni nepoznatim riječima = B (They feel confused).

qs.q:
Reading aloud

"When children are encouraged to read what they want, they are motivated to read more."

How are good readers developed?
A By using digital tools.
B By building their vocabulary.
C By letting them choose their stories.
opts: By letting them choose their stories.
qs.exp: 'When children are encouraged to read WHAT THEY WANT, they are motivated' → pustiti ih da biraju = C.

qs.q:
Japanese eco revolutionist

"He was working as an agricultural customs inspector (16) ___." 

A because he wanted them to change.
B he started to question every aspect of conventional agricultural practice.
C when he was struck down by pneumonia.
D and could therefore function without human intervention.
E and his father set him to work in the mandarin orchard.
F that would not go away even after the illness had passed.
G and Hayashi was an agricultural scientist.
opts: A — because he wanted them to change
B — he started to question every aspect of conventional agriculture
C — when he was struck down by pneumonia
D — and could therefore function without human intervention
E — and his father set him to work in the mandarin orchard
F — that would not go away even after the illness had passed
G — and Hayashi was an agricultural scientist
qs.exp: 'He was working as inspector (16)____. Lying in his hospital bed...' → C: when he was struck down by pneumonia. Inspektor je obolio od upale pluća i završio u bolnici.

Japanese eco revolutionist

"Lying in his hospital bed, an existential crisis took hold of him (17) ___." 

A because he wanted them to change.
B he started to question every aspect of conventional agricultural practice.
C when he was struck down by pneumonia.
D and could therefore function without human intervention.
E and his father set him to work in the mandarin orchard.

E — and his father set him to work in the mandarin orchard
F — that would not go away even after the illness had passed
G — and Hayashi was an agricultural scientist

C when he was struck down by pneumonia.
D and could therefore function without human intervention.
E and his father set him to work in the mandarin orchard.
F that would not go away even after the illness had passed.

opts: A — because he wanted them to change
B — he started to question every aspect of conventional agriculture
C — when he was struck down by pneumonia
D — and could therefore function without human intervention
E — and his father set him to work in the mandarin orchard
F — that would not go away even after the illness had passed
G — and Hayashi was an agricultural scientist

qs.q:
Japanese eco revolutionist

"Nature, he believed, was a complete and unified whole, (20) ___."

C when he was struck down by pneumonia.
D and could therefore function without human intervention.
E and his father set him to work in the mandarin orchard.

qs.q:
Mark's email to Denise

"I hope I can rely on you to prepare everything so I don't (21) ___ time on paperwork when I arrive."

A take
B kill
C waste
qs.exp: 'Don't WASTE time on paperwork' — fiksna kolokacija: waste time (gubiti/trošiti vrijeme).

Mark's email

A up

Mark's email

A have placed

A do

A do

A do

qs.q:
Read the message from Susan:

"Hi Peter,
I'm organising a surprise party for my friend, but I don't have much experience. Which party did you last go to and what was it like? What's the best place for a party and why? What do you think makes a great party? I really want it to be memorable.
Susan"

Write Susan a reply. Answer all her questions. Write 80–100 words.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) na kojoj si zadnjoj zabavi bio/la i kakva je bila, (2) koje je najbolje mjesto za zabavu i zašto, (3) što čini sjajnu zabavu. Dužina 80–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (80–100 riječi).

qs.q:
You will hear five phone messages.
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

A — You should cooperate with them.
B — You've done everything possible.
C — I'll do whatever you want.
D — You can coordinate the activity.
E — I can help out.
F — Give yourself another chance.
rights: A — You should cooperate with them.
C — I'll do whatever you want.
D — You can coordinate the activity.

pairs.r: D — You can coordinate the activity.
A — You should cooperate with them.

qs.exp: Prema službenom ključu: 1=D, 2=B, 3=E, 4=F, 5=A.

qs.q:
You hear a brother and sister talking about getting home on time.
When should they return from tennis practice?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q6 = B (At 2:15).

qs.q:
You hear a man talking to a bank employee.
What is the man's last name?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q7 = C (Roujer).

qs.q:
You hear Joan talking to a friend about a dance group she attends.
What are the people in the dance group like?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q8 = A (They are beginners).

qs.q:
You hear Helen and Paul talking about another person's behaviour.
What does Helen think Paul should do?
opts: Talk to the person about it.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q9 = B (Act as if nothing happened).

qs.q:
You hear Emily talking to a friend.
Why does she want to go away?
opts: To get over a relationship that ended.
To discover what she wants to do in life.
To find out if she can do it.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q10 = B (To discover what she wants to do in life).

qs.q:
You hear a radio interview with Oliver Lynch about his passion, rollerskating.

What does Oliver like most about rollerskating?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q11 = B (Meeting new people).

qs.q: How does Oliver's mother feel about him rollerskating?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q12 = B (She dislikes it).

qs.q: Who influenced Oliver?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q13 = C (A professional).

qs.q: What impressed Oliver about Gretzky?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q14 = C (His speed / brzina).

qs.q: What is Oliver's most important advice?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q15 = B (Learn how to brake / naučiti kočiti).

qs.q:
You hear a text about visiting a theme park.

When was the current model of the park opened?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q16 = C (In 2020).

qs.q: Where can visitors play a game of chess?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q17 = B (Near the lake).

qs.q: Where does the guide suggest having lunch?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q18 = B (The cafeteria).

qs.q: How much is the roller coaster for a single adult?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q19 = B (€10).

qs.q: Where does the coach leave from?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q20 = A (The car park).

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. I'm expecting an important call but I have to leave now. If I'm not back in time, please write down the phone number. [G = Take a message for me.]
1. Don't worry if you don't know what the sign means. Just look at the colours – red always means something's wrong or not allowed. It always works for me.
2. It happens all the time. The streets are very busy today because it's a national holiday. Lots of people have decided to spend it in the countryside. It's a pity I'm on duty.
3. I have a terrible backache, probably because I rearranged the furniture yesterday. I should've asked Tom for help. Now, it's too late.
4. As far as I'm concerned working nine to five isn't attractive because it's always the same and there's little room for creativity. I like doing new and unusual things.
5. I'm glad you're better. Don't worry about the project. You're just a little behind schedule. You can finish over the weekend or we can ask Peter to help you.
items: 1 — Just look at the colours — red always means not allowed.
2 — The streets are busy. It's a pity I'm on duty.
3 — I have a backache. I should've asked Tom for help. Now it's too late.
4 — Working nine to five isn't attractive — always the same, little creativity.
5 — Don't worry about the project. You can finish it or ask Peter for help.
rights: A — I don't like routines in my job.
B — There are some options available.
D — It simply doesn't work that way.
E — The damage has been done.
F — It's as simple as that.
G — Take a message for me.

pairs.l: 1 — Just look at the colours — red always means not allowed.
pairs.r: F — It's as simple as that.

pairs.l: 2 — The streets are busy. It's a pity I'm on duty.
3 — I have a backache. I should've asked Tom for help. Now it's too late.
pairs.r: E — The damage has been done.

pairs.l: 4 — Working nine to five isn't attractive — always the same, little creativity.
pairs.r: A — I don't like routines in my job.

pairs.l: 5 — Don't worry about the project. You can finish it or ask Peter for help.
pairs.r: B — There are some options available.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (samo pogledaj boje — tako jednostavno) = F (It's as simple as that). Poruka 2 (mora raditi na državni praznik) = C (I have to work). Poruka 3 (trebao je pitati za pomoć, ali sad je kasno) = E (The damage has been done). Poruka 4 (ne voli rutinu i jednoličnost posla) = A (I don't like routines). Poruka 5 (ne brini, imaš opcije) = B (There are some options available).

qs.q:
How will they travel to Clardage?

"I've thought about your proposal. Catching the 6.15 sounds good because it takes only 20 minutes to Clardage and goes straight there. This will give us about 30 minutes to grab something to eat before the festival starts."

A By car.
B By taxi.
C By train.
qs.exp: 'Catching the 6.15' = hvatanje vlaka u 6:15. 'Goes straight there' = ide direktno → C (By train).

qs.q:
What is the purpose of the message?

"We are writing to inform you that we have to reschedule our tutoring services for next month. The space we have been renting is no longer available. We are looking for a new place and in the meantime we are considering going online. Would you please fill in the questionnaire that has been attached so we might have your view on this matter?"

A To ask for an opinion.
B To cancel the tutoring.
C To offer online services.
qs.exp: 'Would you please fill in the questionnaire... so we might have YOUR VIEW on this matter?' → traže mišljenje = A (To ask for an opinion).

qs.q:
Why is he going to miss the celebration?

"I'd like to come to your parents' wedding anniversary next month, but my building project in India starts soon. All the paperwork has been done but unstable weather means we had to postpone it a few times. The weather is OK now so we're flying out next week to finish it. It should take about 8 weeks."

A Because the weather will be bad.
B Because he will be abroad.
C Because he will be flying.
opts: Because the weather will be bad.
qs.exp: 'We're flying out next week to finish it. It should take about 8 weeks.' → bit će u Indiji (u inozemstvu) = B (Because he will be abroad).

qs.q:
Who is the message for?

"We agreed to share responsibilities, but you're not doing your part. Last week your leftover pizza was on the sofa for two days, and my girlfriend sat on it. Then you promised to turn down the music while I was studying but you didn't. So, since you've paid the rent, you can stay until the end of the month but start looking for a new place immediately."

A His flatmate.
B His landlord.
C His girlfriend.
qs.exp: 'We agreed to share responsibilities', pizza na sofi, buka, 'start looking for a new place' → poruka je za cimera = A (His flatmate).

qs.q:
Where is the person?

"They've been taking good care of me so my condition is improving. When I was admitted yesterday after the class, the situation looked pretty bad and not at all promising, but everyone has been very professional. I hope I'll leave soon since my insurance might not cover all the expenses."

A At work.
B At school.
C At hospital.
qs.exp: 'When I was ADMITTED', 'condition is improving', 'insurance might not cover expenses' → u bolnici = C (At hospital).

qs.q:
Rob Stein

"Well, my first language is German. I feel Austrian, but I love to travel, and when I'm in New York I'm American. When I go to Italy I'm Italian. I'm changeable."

Which is Rob's country of origin?
A Italy.
B Austria.
C Germany.

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. Something's come up about the conference in Munich. Really important. We have to make a decision. Get back to me. [G = We need to talk.]
1. I thought I told you the report was needed by lunchtime today. I don't see it on my desk. I hope you haven't lost it.
2. Tony told me you talked to Sandra this morning and explained the situation. I hope it wasn't too upsetting. Anyway, let me know how she took it.
3. Hey guys. Helena's not well so we've had to call it off. We can think of something else to surprise her.
4. I heard you were called in by the principal. Did he blame you for the broken computer? I'm sure he blew up like a volcano. But relax. He'll forget about it in a few days.
5. I'm a little bit worried about Frank's work on his project. It's way behind schedule. If he doesn't start working faster, he'll be in trouble.
items: 1 — The report was needed by lunchtime. I don't see it on my desk.
2 — Let me know how she took it.
3 — Helena's not well so we've had to call it off.
4 — He blew up like a volcano. But relax. He'll forget about it.
5 — Frank's project is way behind schedule.
rights: C — He needs to hurry up.

pairs.l: 1 — The report was needed by lunchtime. I don't see it on my desk.
2 — Let me know how she took it.
3 — Helena's not well so we've had to call it off.
4 — He blew up like a volcano. But relax. He'll forget about it.
5 — Frank's project is way behind schedule.
pairs.r: C — He needs to hurry up.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (ne vidi izvješće na stolu) = D (Where is it?). Poruka 2 (javi mi kako je reagirala) = E (What was her reaction?). Poruka 3 (otkazano jer Helena nije dobro) = A (It's not happening). Poruka 4 (direktor se razbjesnio, ali opusti se, zaboravit će) = B (Don't worry about it). Poruka 5 (Frankov projekt kasni) = C (He needs to hurry up).

She likes cookies and ice cream.
She belongs to a former teacher.

A His dogs sat with him around the fire.

His dogs knew the names of the sheep.
His dogs' names were Molly and Tolly.

A They learn best when people play with them.
B They learn best when they are in a group.
C They learn best when they are alone.

They learn best when they are in a group.
They learn best when they are alone.

qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q6 = C (To ski / skijanje).

qs.q:
You will hear a woman making a restaurant reservation.
What is her name?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q7 = B (Ms Jeanson).

qs.q:
You will hear two sisters talking about their brother.
What has just happened?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q8 = C (He has injured himself / ozlijedio se).

qs.q:
You will hear a boy talking about his mother.
What does he say about her?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q9 = A (She can worry too much / previše brine).

qs.q:
You will hear two colleagues talking about a business trip.
Where are they going?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q10 = B (Vienna / Beč).

qs.q:
You hear a radio interview with Gordon Ferrero about mountain-climbing.

How did he become interested in climbing mountains?
opts: He saw a painting of mountains.
He read a book about mountains.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q11 = A (He saw a painting of mountains).

qs.q: When did he decide to climb all Seven Summits?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q12 = C (After he climbed Kilimanjaro).

qs.q: Why was climbing Kilimanjaro difficult for Gordon?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q13 = A (He was very young / bio je jako mlad).

qs.q: What did he do during his travelling in Kenya and Tanzania?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q14 = B (He saw natural wonders / vidio prirodne ljepote).

qs.q: Why does Gordon train with his dad?
opts: His dad is a mountain climber as well.
His dad has a lot of climbing experience.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q15 = C (His dad is good company / tata mu je dobro društvo).

qs.q:
You hear a teacher talking to students about a field trip to the Marine Science Centre.

When will they enter the Marine Science Centre?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q16 = B (At 9:30).

qs.q: Which programme has the teacher booked?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q17 = A (The Exhibit Tour).

qs.q: What will they visit last?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q18 = A (The Turtle Terrace).

qs.q: Where will they have lunch?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q19 = B (In the park).

qs.q: How much does the Prime dolphin adoption package cost?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q20 = C (€50).

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. She should apologise to me. I didn't start it but when she yelled at me I didn't shut up. I have no regrets. You should be proud of me.
2. I have to tell you something. I've read your poems. They're great, so sensitive and deep. My girl is a real poet. I love being your mum.
3. You can't ignore the reality. Being honest is hard but I'll be with you when you break the news to him. The sooner you do it, the better you'll feel.
4. Your last drawings are really fantastic. Everybody can see that. Don't listen to what your classmates say. They don't get it anyway. I think they're probably jealous of your talent.
5. No one has to know what you're going through right now. People have no clue about anything. Keep it to yourself for your own good. Just trust me.
items: 1 — I didn't start it, I didn't shut up, no regrets.
2 — I've read your poems — you're a real poet. I love being your mum.
3 — Being honest is hard, but the sooner you do it, the better.
4 — Your drawings are fantastic. Don't listen to your classmates — they're jealous.
5 — No one has to know. Keep it to yourself.

pairs.l: 1 — I didn't start it, I didn't shut up, no regrets.
2 — I've read your poems — you're a real poet. I love being your mum.
3 — Being honest is hard, but the sooner you do it, the better.
4 — Your drawings are fantastic. Don't listen to your classmates — they're jealous.
5 — No one has to know. Keep it to yourself.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (nije počela, ne žali) = D (I'm not sorry). Poruka 2 (mama je ponosna na pjesme) = B (I'm proud of you). Poruka 3 (budi iskren, reci mu istinu) = E (Tell the truth). Poruka 4 (ignoriraj razredne kolege, ljubomorni su) = A (Ignore them). Poruka 5 (nitko ne mora znati, zadrži za sebe) = C (Don't tell anyone).

qs.q:
How much dog food does Ms Bates need?

"This is Charles from the Pet Shop. About your order for 20 kg of Bonzo food. Unfortunately, that particular brand only comes in 15 kg bags, or 30 kg bags. Could you please tell us which size you would prefer, or if you'd rather order a different brand."

A 15 kg.
B 20 kg.
C 30 kg.
qs.exp: Ms Bates je naručila 20 kg → to je njena potreba (B). Charles objašnjava da ta veličina nije dostupna, ali njezina narudžba je bila za 20 kg.

qs.q:
What did Linda think of the plan?

"I showed Linda the plan of our trip. She wasn't exactly thrilled about having to spend a third night in Frankfurt in that super expensive hotel. Not that I mind too much! And she had some questions about the schedule on Day 1, which certainly looks very busy. But in the end she gave it the green light."

A She wasn't happy about it.
B She was unsure about it.
C She agreed with it.
qs.exp: 'In the end she gave it the GREEN LIGHT' = odobrila je plan → C (She agreed with it).

qs.q:
Why does Bella want to make the trip?

"I really think we should make a trip and visit Nick. It's not an excuse to get out of town for a while, I promise. It's just that I spoke to him yesterday and I didn't like the sound of his voice. Not one little bit."

A To get out of town.
B She's worried about Nick.
C To eat in her favourite restaurant.
opts: To eat in her favourite restaurant.
qs.exp: 'I spoke to him yesterday and I didn't like the sound of his voice' → Bella je zabrinuta za Nicka (B).

qs.q:
What does Ben say about himself?

"Sorry I haven't been in touch for so long. Things have been busy as always. Work, the kids, and so on. Normal stuff. And also, I don't know, I suppose I'm just a bit sad. Maybe I'm just sick and tired of things. Lucy thinks I should look around for a different job."

A He's been unusually busy.
B He's feeling down.
C He's been unwell.
qs.exp: 'I'm just a bit sad. Maybe I'm just sick and tired of things.' → osjeća se loše (B = He's feeling down).

qs.q:
Where will they meet?

"The bus leaves at 7.00 am. Sean suggested we meet outside the station, but it's always so crowded there, even on Saturdays because of the market. And the station coffee shop is a dump. So we'll meet in our seats."

A Outside the bus station.
B In the station coffee bar.
C On the bus.
qs.exp: 'We'll meet in our seats' = na autobusnim sjedalima → sastaju se na autobusu (C = On the bus).

qs.q:
Award Winning Stuntman

"Alejandro was born in 1982, and a year later they decided to leave New Mexico. And a year after that they went to seek their fortune in Los Angeles."

When did Alejandro move to Los Angeles?
A In 1982.
B In 1983.
C In 1984.
qs.exp: Rođen 1982., godinu dana kasnije (1983.) napustili su New Mexico, godinu dana nakon toga (1984.) otišli u Los Angeles → C (In 1984.).

qs.q:
Award Winning Stuntman

"His twin sisters were born two years later and they all made brilliant careers in the movie business, even his much younger brother Enrique."

How many brothers and sisters has Alejandro got?
A Two.
B Three.
C Four.
qs.exp: Dvije sestre blizanke + mlađi brat Enrique = ukupno 3 braće/sestara (B).

qs.q:
Award Winning Stuntman

"After graduating from school he considered becoming a baker. However, it was clear to everybody that he was destined for more exciting things, so he started working as a lifeguard. Soon, he was offered a small role in an action movie."

What was Alejandro's first job?
A He was a baker.
B He was an actor.
C He was a lifeguard.
qs.exp: 'He started working as a lifeguard' — to je bio prvi posao (C). Pekara je razmatrao ali nije postalo; glumac je bio tek nakon spasioca.

qs.q:
Award Winning Stuntman

"Back in the early 2000s, when he started out, a daily rate was $600. Nowadays, however, top stuntmen like Alejandro get paid up to $5000, depending on the stunt. But the average is $1000 a day for a beginner."

How much was Alejandro paid at the beginning of his career?
A $600 per day.
B $1000 per day.
C $5000 per day.
qs.exp: 'When he started out, a daily rate was $600' → na početku karijere zaradio je $600 na dan (A).

qs.q:
Award Winning Stuntman

"He broke 56 bones, including his back, dislocated a shoulder three times, knocked out several teeth and punctured a lung, which almost cost him his life."

What was the most serious injury Alejandro had?
A Broken bones.
B A punctured lung.
C A dislocated shoulder.
qs.exp: 'Punctured a lung, which almost cost him his life' → probodena pluća je bila najteža ozljeda jer mu je gotovo oduzela život (B).

qs.q:
Ghost nets

"Fishing nets lost in the ocean, called ghost nets, (16) ___." 

A national governments do nothing about the problem
B and from these safe places, they look for food
C which increases the chance of new victims
D because they become hooked
E continue to catch fish for many years
F none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G a material that is much stronger and cheaper
opts: B — and from these safe places, they look for food
C — which increases the chance of new victims
E — continue to catch fish for many years
F — none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G — a material that is much stronger and cheaper
qs.exp: 'Ghost nets (16)____. Because of this, hundreds of millions of marine animals are killed.' → E: continue to catch fish for many years. Napuštene mreže nastavljaju hvatati ribe godinama.

qs.q:
Ghost nets

"There is plenty of life around abandoned fishing nets, (17) ___." 

A national governments do nothing
B and from these safe places, they look for food
C which increases the chance of new victims
D because they become hooked
E continue to catch fish for many years
F none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G a material that is much stronger and cheaper
opts: B — and from these safe places, they look for food
C — which increases the chance of new victims
E — continue to catch fish for many years
F — none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G — a material that is much stronger and cheaper
qs.exp: 'Plenty of life around abandoned nets, (17)____.' → C: which increases the chance of new victims. Gdje ima života, ima i novih žrtava.

qs.q:
Ghost nets

"Sea turtles look for floating objects to hide under them (18) ___." 

A national governments do nothing
B and from these safe places, they look for food
C which increases the chance of new victims
D because they become hooked
E continue to catch fish for many years
F none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G a material that is much stronger and cheaper
opts: B — and from these safe places, they look for food
C — which increases the chance of new victims
E — continue to catch fish for many years
F — none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G — a material that is much stronger and cheaper
qs.exp: 'Sea turtles look for floating objects to hide under them (18)____.' → B: and from these safe places, they look for food. Kornjače se sakrivaju, a zatim traže hranu.

qs.q:
Ghost nets

"The problem of ghost nets has been known for years but (19) ___." 

A national governments do nothing
B and from these safe places, they look for food
C which increases the chance of new victims
D because they become hooked
E continue to catch fish for many years
F none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G a material that is much stronger and cheaper
opts: B — and from these safe places, they look for food
C — which increases the chance of new victims
E — continue to catch fish for many years
F — none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G — a material that is much stronger and cheaper
qs.exp: 'The problem has been known for years but (19)____. Even though one of them, Fishing Ltd, did mention the problem...' → F: none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action.

qs.q:
Ghost nets

"This is why (20) ___, which mainly occurs in international waters." 

A national governments do nothing
B and from these safe places, they look for food
C which increases the chance of new victims
D because they become hooked
E continue to catch fish for many years
F none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G a material that is much stronger and cheaper
opts: B — and from these safe places, they look for food
C — which increases the chance of new victims
E — continue to catch fish for many years
F — none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action
G — a material that is much stronger and cheaper
qs.exp: 'This is why (20)____, which mainly occurs in international waters.' → A: national governments do nothing about the problem. Vlade ne poduzimaju ništa, posebno u međunarodnim vodama.

qs.q:
Four Women Who Made History in the Sciences

"The early programming language 'Ada' was named after (21) ___."

A that
B her
C hers
qs.exp: 'Named after HER' — osobna zamjenica u objektnom padežu (Ada Lovelace = her).

qs.q:
Four Women Who Made History in the Sciences

"Marie Curie was the first person to receive medals in two different fields, (22) ___ physics and chemistry."

A also
B both
C only
qs.exp: 'In two different fields, BOTH physics and chemistry' — 'both' naglašava da su oba polja obuhvaćena.

qs.q:
Four Women Who Made History in the Sciences

"Together with Pierre Curie she discovered two elements, radium and polonium, for (23) ___ she received her second Nobel Prize."

A which
B what
C that
qs.exp: 'For WHICH she received her second Nobel Prize' — relativna zamjenica 'which' u prepozicijskoj relativnoj surečenici.

qs.q:
Four Women Who Made History in the Sciences

"Jane Goodall is an expert in chimpanzees as well as the (24) ___ important scientist in her field."

A very
B more
C most
qs.exp: 'The MOST important scientist in her field' — superlativ: the most + adjective.

qs.q:
Four Women Who Made History in the Sciences

"Nowadays she is well (25) ___ for being a major activist fighting to save the planet."

A famous
B popular
C known
qs.exp: 'Well KNOWN for being an activist' — fiksna kolokacija: well known for (dobro poznat po).

qs.q:
Product testers

"They provide feedback on the items, before the items can (26) ___ it to the shelves."

A its
B make
C her
D out
E put
F on
G get
qs.exp: 'Before items can MAKE IT to the shelves' — fiksni izraz: make it to = uspjeti doći/stići do.

qs.q:
Product testers

"The best advantage of being a product tester is getting to try (27) ___ new goods before anyone else."

A its
B make
C her
D out
E put
F on
G get
qs.exp: 'Getting to try OUT new goods' — frazalni glagol: try out = isprobati (nešto novo).

qs.q:
Product testers

"Some luxury bed companies organize surveys for feedback on how to (28) ___ a good night's sleep."

A its
B make
C her
D out
E put
F on
G get
qs.exp: 'How to GET a good night's sleep' — fiksna kolokacija: get a good night's sleep (dobro spavati).

qs.q:
Product testers

"One company in England hired a student to sleep in (29) ___ beds for a month."

A its
B make
C her
D out
E put
F on
G get
qs.exp: 'Sleep in ITS beds' — posvojno 'its' odnosi se na tvrtku (the company's beds = its beds).

qs.q:
Product testers

"Thanks to (30) ___ writing skills she was chosen over hundreds of others."

A its
B make
C her
D out
E put
F on
G get
qs.exp: 'Thanks to HER writing skills' — posvojno 'her' odnosi se na studenticu (the student's skills = her skills).

qs.q:
Read the message from Peter:

"Hi, Laura!
I was almost late for my exam today because of heavy traffic. How did you travel this morning? How do you prefer to get around town and why? What are the biggest transport problems where you live?
Peter"

Write Peter a reply. Answer all his questions. Write 70–100 words.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kako si putovao/la jutros, (2) kako preferiraš kretanje po gradu i zašto, (3) najveći prometni problemi gdje živiš. Dužina 70–100 riječi (dulje nego u ranijim godinama!). Neformalan registar.

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (70–100 riječi). Napomena: od 2022. zadatak pisanja traži 70–100 riječi (ranije 50–70).

qs.q:
You will hear five phone messages.
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

A — I need a favour.
B — Take your time.
C — I'm glad to help.
D — Wait for me.
E — It's not too late.
F — I've gone out.
qs.exp: Prema službenom ključu: 1=C, 2=F, 3=A, 4=E, 5=B.

qs.q:
You hear a man talking to a hotel receptionist.
What is his surname?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q6 = B (Mr Foege).

qs.q:
You hear Ben complaining about his sister.
What is she like?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q7 = C (Bossy / zapovijedajuća).

qs.q:
You hear a boy talking about a school trip.
Why doesn't he want to go?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q8 = A (He's afraid of heights / boji se visine).

qs.q:
You hear a couple talking about their daughter.
Why are they proud of her right now?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q9 = A (She's kind / ljubazna je).

qs.q:
You hear a teacher giving instructions for a task.
What must her students do?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q10 = C (Write a text).

qs.q:
You hear a radio interview with chef Harmer about his career.

How long has chef Harmer been cooking professionally?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q11 = C (For 15 years).

qs.q: Where was his first job?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q12 = B (In Paris).

qs.q: Who supported chef Harmer the most?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q13 = C (His teacher).

qs.q: What does he like best about his job?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q14 = B (The dishes he creates).

qs.q: What is the reason he has opened one more restaurant?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q15 = A (His dream / njegov san).

qs.q:
You hear a teacher describing a school trip to parents.

The trip will last…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q16 = B (8 days).

qs.q: The price of the trip includes…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q17 = A (tickets and hotel).

qs.q: Those coming on the trip are advised to pack…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q18 = C (a strong pair of trainers / dobre tenisice).

qs.q: During the trip, they will visit…
opts: 3 cities, a seaside resort, and a nature park.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q19 = B (3 cities and a seaside resort).

qs.q: They need to be at the airport at…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q20 = B (4:00 am).

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. Thanks for the invitation to the party, but I'm stuck at the office working on a huge project and my boss is going crazy.
2. All games are strictly prohibited by order of Kimberly County Council. Offenders will be punished.
3. I know it's an important exam, and you really want to do well, but if you allow your nerves to win, you will fail. Chill.
4. In the event of any damage to persons or property for any reason whatsoever, the company will not take blame.
5. I'm telling you, these guys are professionals, with years of experience behind them.
items: 1 — Thanks for the invitation, but I'm stuck at the office.
2 — All games are strictly prohibited. Offenders will be punished.
3 — Don't let your nerves win. Chill.
4 — In the event of any damage, the company will not take blame.
5 — These guys are professionals, with years of experience.
rights: D — They know what they're doing.
F — I'm running out of time.

pairs.l: 1 — Thanks for the invitation, but I'm stuck at the office.
2 — All games are strictly prohibited. Offenders will be punished.
3 — Don't let your nerves win. Chill.
4 — In the event of any damage, the company will not take blame.
5 — These guys are professionals, with years of experience.
pairs.r: D — They know what they're doing.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (zapela na poslu, ne mogu doći) = C (I can't make it). Poruka 2 (igre zabranjene, prekršitelji će biti kažnjeni) = B (They are not allowed). Poruka 3 (opusti se na ispitu) = E (Relax). Poruka 4 (firma ne preuzima odgovornost za štetu) = A (We are not responsible). Poruka 5 (profesionalci su, znaju što rade) = D (They know what they're doing).

qs.q:
What time will they meet?

"I'm working till around 5.00 pm and it will take me at least half an hour to get there. Providing the traffic is not too bad. Just to be on the safe side I'll give myself 45 minutes, so we'll have an hour for a drink before the film starts."

A At 5.30.
B At 5.45.
C At 6.45.
qs.exp: Završava rad u 17:00, daje si 45 minuta za put → 17:00 + 0:45 = 17:45 (B = At 5.45).

qs.q:
Why does Tia want to go to Spain?

"About the holidays, I really think we should go to Spain. If I don't get some sun after these gloomy months, I will go crazy. And despite what the children said last night, they always enjoy seeing grandad and grandma."

A Because of the weather.
B Because the children said they wanted to.
C To see her grandparents.
opts: Because the children said they wanted to.
qs.exp: 'If I don't get some sun after these gloomy months, I will go crazy' → želi sunce/dobro vrijeme = A (Because of the weather).

qs.q:
What does Edward want Bill to tell him?

"I'm coming down your way next week for a convention at the Taj Mahal Hotel. Can you suggest the best way to get to the Taj Mahal? And I insist you take me to the finest restaurant in town!"

A The cost of the hotels.
B Transport directions.
C The name of the best restaurant.
opts: The name of the best restaurant.
qs.exp: Edward pita 'can you suggest the best way to GET TO the Taj Mahal?' → traži upute za prijevoz/transport (B = Transport directions).

qs.q:
Why was Lucy embarrassed?

"I've never been so embarrassed in all my life. Okay, I know Tony was in a terrible mood, but really, to say such things to my mother! I know I can be too hard on him sometimes, and he has every right to criticise me. But only me!"

A Because Tony was criticized.
B Because Tony criticized her.
C Because Tony criticized her mother.
qs.exp: Lucy kaže 'to say such things to MY MOTHER!' → Tony je kritizirao njezinu majku, što ju je posramilo (C).

qs.q:
What was the weather like during the trip?

"It was a fantastic trip, even if the weather was a bit of a mixed bag. It was like we had all four seasons at once! Rainy one moment, sunny the next. The only thing it didn't do was snow."

A Changeable.
B Rainy.
C Snowy.
qs.exp: 'Mixed bag... all four seasons at once... rainy one moment, sunny the next' → promjenljivo (A = Changeable).

qs.q:
Ariel, the mermaid

"At 16 I moved to London... Now, five years later, I know leaving London was a life-saving decision."

Question 11: How old is Ariel now?
qs.exp: Preselila se u London sa 16 godina, a sada je 5 godina poslije → 16 + 5 = 21 godina.

qs.q:
Ariel, the mermaid

"At 16 I moved to London. Unfortunately I didn't have many friends or family there although I was born there."

Question 12: Where was Ariel born?
qs.exp: 'Although I was born there' — 'there' se odnosi na London → Ariel je rođena u Londonu.

qs.q:
Ariel, the mermaid

"The doctors and nurses at the hospital, where I work as a receptionist, are incredibly supportive."

Question 13: What is Ariel's present job?
qs.exp: 'Where I work as a receptionist' → sadašnji posao je receptionist (u bolnici).

qs.q:
Ariel, the mermaid

"I started working as a fitness instructor but I soon quit."

Question 14: What was Ariel's previous job?
qs.exp: 'I started working as a fitness instructor but I soon quit' → prethodni posao je fitness instructor.

qs.q:
Ariel, the mermaid

"Although most of my friends were too scared to go swimming after watching The Shark, the film Splash played a huge part in my childhood and I spent lots of time under water."

Question 15: Which movie inspired Ariel to swim?
qs.exp: 'The film Splash played a huge part in my childhood and I spent lots of time under water' → inspirativni film je Splash.

qs.q:
Eco-friendly living

"There are small changes you can introduce into your daily life (16) ____." 

A that you actually need and use
B which of them can be recycled
C that take very little time or effort
D if you only purchase what's necessary
E because that can save more than you'd think
F if you stop buying from companies that use it
G that you don't have time to be eco-friendly
opts: A — that you actually need and use
B — which of them can be recycled
C — that take very little time or effort
D — if you only purchase what's necessary
E — because that can save more than you'd think
F — if you stop buying from companies that use it
G — that you don't have time to be eco-friendly
qs.exp: 'Small changes you can introduce into your daily life (16)____. And they can save you a lot of money.' → C: that take very little time or effort. Male promjene koje ne zahtijevaju puno truda.

qs.q:
Eco-friendly living

"When you're throwing away objects made of paper, plastic or something else, it's important to think about (17) ____." 

A that you actually need and use
B which of them can be recycled
C that take very little time or effort
D if you only purchase what's necessary
E because that can save more than you'd think
F if you stop buying from companies that use it
G that you don't have time to be eco-friendly
opts: A — that you actually need and use
B — which of them can be recycled
C — that take very little time or effort
D — if you only purchase what's necessary
E — because that can save more than you'd think
F — if you stop buying from companies that use it
G — that you don't have time to be eco-friendly
qs.exp: 'When throwing away objects, think about (17)____.' → B: which of them can be recycled (koji se mogu reciklirati).

qs.q:
Eco-friendly living

"Only buy things (18) ____." 

A that you actually need and use
B which of them can be recycled
C that take very little time or effort
D if you only purchase what's necessary
E because that can save more than you'd think
F if you stop buying from companies that use it
G that you don't have time to be eco-friendly
opts: A — that you actually need and use
B — which of them can be recycled
C — that take very little time or effort
D — if you only purchase what's necessary
E — because that can save more than you'd think
F — if you stop buying from companies that use it
G — that you don't have time to be eco-friendly
qs.exp: 'Only buy things (18)____. In a consumer culture, it's easy to fall into the habit of overbuying.' → A: that you actually need and use (koje stvarno trebaš i koristiš).

qs.q:
Extreme Weather

"The frequency of extreme weather events around the world (21) ___ increasing."

A is
B were
C was
qs.exp: 'The frequency... IS increasing' — subjekt je 'frequency' (jednina) → prezent kontinuirani: is + gerund.

qs.q:
Extreme Weather

"The West Coast of the United States was struck (22) ___ extreme flooding."

A for
B by
C in
qs.exp: 'Was struck BY extreme flooding' — pasivna konstrukcija: be struck by (agent se uvodi s 'by').

qs.q:
Extreme Weather

"Sudan is in the middle of a humanitarian crisis (23) ___ being hit by severe drought and famine."

A after
B during
C before
qs.exp: 'Humanitarian crisis AFTER being hit by drought' — kriza je nastala nakon što je Sudan pogođen sušom i glađu.

qs.q:
Extreme Weather

"While climate change often means higher average temperatures, we (24) ___ see that much more drastic changes influence specific locations."

A could
B would
C can
qs.exp: 'We CAN see that more drastic changes influence specific locations' — modalni glagol sposobnosti/mogućnosti u sadašnjosti: can.

qs.q:
Extreme Weather

"This results in intense weather events (25) ___ as sudden hail and flash floods."

A much
B such
C so
qs.exp: 'Events SUCH AS sudden hail and flash floods' — fiksni izraz za primjer: 'such as' = kao što su.

qs.q:
Sushi

"It originated in Japan thousands of years ago, but it (26) ___ evolved to suit the taste of North America and Europe."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'It HAS evolved' — present perfect: has + past participle. Evolucija je počela u prošlosti i relevantna je danas.

Sushi

"Some people think (27) ___ sushi chefs as raw fish bartenders who play with food."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'Think OF sushi chefs as...' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: think of someone/something as.

qs.q:
Sushi

"Sushi chefs create their masterpieces with (28) ___ wide variety of seafood."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'With A wide variety of seafood' — neodređeni član 'a' uz 'wide variety'.

qs.q:
Sushi

"These ingredients are then combined with rice and vegetables (29) ___ create sushi."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'Combined with rice and vegetables TO create sushi' — infinitiv svrhe: 'to create'.

qs.q:
Sushi

"All ingredients must (30) ___ fresh and of high quality."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'Must BE fresh' — modalni glagol 'must' + infinitiv bez 'to': must be.

qs.q:
Read the message from Jack:

"Hi
I was sick yesterday. What did I miss at school?
What did the teacher say about the school trip next week?
And, most important of course, what happened in the school football finals?
Jack"

Write Jack a reply. Answer all his questions. Write 50–70 words.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) što je Jack propustio u školi, (2) što je učitelj rekao o školskom izletu, (3) što se dogodilo na školskom finalu u nogometu. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi).

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. I've finished my project, so we should get together to compare the results.
2. I was under the impression that you weren't going to Rick's party. If you are, think twice. Because we can have a much better time doing something else.
3. I've seen your new house. You've done so much more than I expected and you'll be able to move in soon.
4. I'm glad you're coming over. When you get off the bus, cross the road and turn left. My house is the green one. You'll see it right away.
5. You say I shouldn't go skiing because I have to study. I agree, but I'll miss the beautiful mountains.
items: 1 — I've finished my project, let's compare results.
2 — Think twice about Rick's party. We can do something better.
3 — I've seen your new house. You've done more than expected.
4 — Cross the road and turn left. You'll see it right away.
5 — I agree I shouldn't go skiing, but I'll miss the mountains.

pairs.l: 1 — I've finished my project, let's compare results.
2 — Think twice about Rick's party. We can do something better.
3 — I've seen your new house. You've done more than expected.
4 — Cross the road and turn left. You'll see it right away.
5 — I agree I shouldn't go skiing, but I'll miss the mountains.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (završio/la projekt) = E (I'm done). Poruka 2 (ne idi na Rickovu zabavu) = C (You shouldn't go). Poruka 3 (vidjela sam tvoju novu kuću, impresivno) = B (I'm impressed). Poruka 4 (skreni lijevo, odmah ćeš je vidjeti) = F (You can't miss it). Poruka 5 (slažem se, ne bih trebala ići skijati) = A (You're right).

qs.q:
What was Josie's trip like?

"I'm back. The flight didn't last long so there wasn't enough time to be afraid. The trip was full of activities and we had some real adventures. I'll tell you all about them when we meet, as soon as I finish unpacking. It's such a bore."

A Interesting.
B Boring.
C Scary.
qs.exp: 'The trip was full of activities and we had some real adventures' → uzbudljivo/zanimljivo (A = Interesting). Dosadnim smatra jedino raspakiranje.

qs.q:
What is Martha going to give Alice for her birthday?

"It's Alice's 18th birthday on Saturday and we have to get her something. She's dropped me a hint saying she saw this great sweater at B&M, while my original idea was to give her a beautiful book. Then I thought again and settled for a designer bracelet. Ok?"

A Clothes.
B A book.
C Jewelry.
qs.exp: Martha je na kraju odabrala 'a designer bracelet' (dizajnersku narukvicu) → nakit (C = Jewelry).

qs.q:
Why did Anna miss school?

"I am writing to excuse my daughter Anna Smith for missing school today. She had a bad fall getting off the bus. Her knee was swollen and she couldn't walk. I will bring you the doctor's note after we see him later today."

A She was at the doctor's.
B She missed the bus.
C She hurt her leg.
qs.exp: 'She had a bad fall... her knee was swollen and she couldn't walk' → ozlijedila je nogu (C = She hurt her leg). Kod liječnika tek idu poslije.

qs.q:
When did Tom return from his journey?

"I know you were expecting me on Sunday. I actually wanted to surprise you and come two days earlier. Unfortunately, because of some problems with my car, I came back two days later!"

A On Tuesday.
B On Friday.
C On Sunday.
qs.exp: Očekivan je u nedjelju. Htio je doći 2 dana ranije (petak), ali je zbog kvara na autu stigao 2 dana kasnije od nedjeljnog plana → nedjelja + 2 = utorak (A = Tuesday).

qs.q:
How many friends did Anna invite to her party?

"My birthday party is on Saturday and I wanted to invite 15 friends over but my Mum said I'm not allowed to invite more than 10 because our apartment is too small. I had to leave out 5 people, but you're not one of them!"

A 5.
B 10.
C 15.
qs.exp: Majka je dopustila max 10 prijatelja → Anna je pozvala 10 (B).
