B and they make only one round trip
C those that do so during the summer
D which will kill them if they wait too long
E they must prepare for their long journey
F those were threatened by natural disasters
G that brings millions of them to California and Mexico each winter

B — and they make only one round trip
C — those that do so during the summer
D — which will kill them if they wait too long
E — they must prepare for their long journey
F — those were threatened by natural disasters
G — that brings millions to California and Mexico each winter

B have told

Polar bears – Fact file

Upiši jednu riječ.

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. Can you please lend me your notebook? I will return it as soon as possible. I give you my word. [G = I promise.]
1. I won't come back to say goodbye, so please drive safely and have a nice trip.
2. He promised to return with the book tonight so I'll give you a ring when he gets home.
3. I can't tell you how terrible I feel about the whole thing with Jack but please understand, I just couldn't call you. I know I should have.
4. What have you decided about Eugene's promise? Let me know right away. I'll be by the phone so don't keep me waiting.
5. I called you to tell you how much I miss you and need you here so make my wish come true and don't stay away any longer.
items: 1 — I won't come back to say goodbye. Drive safely.
2 — I'll give you a ring when he gets home.
3 — I feel terrible about the whole thing with Jack.
4 — Let me know right away. I'll be by the phone.
5 — Don't stay away any longer. Come back.

pairs.l: 1 — I won't come back to say goodbye. Drive safely.
2 — I'll give you a ring when he gets home.
3 — I feel terrible about the whole thing with Jack.
4 — Let me know right away. I'll be by the phone.
5 — Don't stay away any longer. Come back.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (vozi pažljivo, lijepo putuj) = C (Take care). Poruka 2 (nazvat ću te kad dođe kući) = A (I'll call you). Poruka 3 (žao mi je što nisam nazvala) = B (I'm sorry). Poruka 4 (čekam kraj telefona, javi odmah) = D (Call me). Poruka 5 (ne ostaj dulje, vrati se) = F (Come back).

qs.q:
Why is Dana going to Lisbon?

"I'm taking the plane to Lisbon tomorrow and will spend two months there. I've finally got that scholarship for the management course I was telling you about. It's going to be a lot of work but I'm looking forward to it. It will be like a holiday compared to studying back home."

A To study.
B To work.
C To have a holiday.
qs.exp: Dana ide na stipendiju za tečaj menadžmenta → studirati (A = To study). Kaže da će biti puno rada, ali to je tečaj/studij.

qs.q:
Which chore did Martha do?

"Jane and I decided to do some chores around the house. And you know my Mum never lets us clean the windows. So it was either the washing up or washing the car. Since the dishes are Jane's favourite, you know what I was left with."

A She cleaned the windows.
B She did the washing up.
C She washed the car.
qs.exp: Prozori su zabranjeni, suđe je Jane uzela (njezin omiljeni posao) → Martha je oprala auto (C).

qs.q:
When does Anna want to meet Tina?

"When we talked this morning you said you were too busy to get together in the afternoon, so we agreed to meet in the evening. But we're having guests this evening so I'm busy then. How about an early start tomorrow?"

A In the evening.
B Tomorrow morning.
C Tomorrow afternoon.
qs.exp: Anna predlaže 'an early start tomorrow' = rano sutra → sutra ujutro (B = Tomorrow morning).

qs.q:
Why does Tom shop at the local grocery store?

"I buy groceries in the shop nearby although it's more expensive than the supermarket. It's a two-minute walk to the supermarket and five to the shop, but I feel I'm doing something for the local shop owners."

A He wants to help the owner.
B The owner has the best prices.
C It is closest to his home.
opts: He wants to help the owner.
The owner has the best prices.
It is closest to his home.
qs.exp: Tom kaže 'I feel I'm doing something for the local shop owners' → želi pomoći vlasniku (A). Dućan je skuplji i dalje od supermarketa.

qs.q:
Where are Mike, John and Mary meeting?

"We said we'd meet at my place, but I ran into John in the park and he told me we were meeting in front of the cinema. Now I'm confused. So let's go with the first thing we agreed on so we don't miss each other."

A In front of the cinema.
B At Mary's place.
C In the park.
qs.exp: Mary kaže 'let's go with the FIRST thing we agreed on' = prvotni dogovor je bio kod nje → B (At Mary's place).

qs.q:
Professional Queuer

"Dimitri Rosi... After years of working as a researcher, he lost his job two years ago at the age of 40."

Question 11: How old is Dimitri Rosi now?
qs.exp: Izgubio je posao u dobi od 40 godina, a to je bilo prije 2 godine → sada ima 42 godine.

qs.q:
Professional Queuer

"After years of working as a researcher, he lost his job two years ago."

Question 12: What was Dimitri's previous job?
qs.exp: Tekst kaže 'after years of working as a researcher' → prethodni posao je bio istraživač (researcher).

qs.q:
Professional Queuer

"As a chemistry graduate he moved to Milan."

Question 13: What is Dimitri's university degree in?
qs.exp: 'A chemistry graduate' → diplomirao je kemiju (Chemistry).

qs.q:
Professional Queuer

"He charges 10 € an hour and so far, business is booming."

Question 14: How much does Dimitri charge per hour?
qs.exp: Tekst eksplicitno kaže 'He charges 10 € an hour'.

qs.q:
Professional Queuer

"He lived in Salerno until 25, and as a chemistry graduate he moved to Milan and he has lived there ever since."

Question 15: What town does Dimitri currently live in?
qs.exp: 'He moved to Milan and he has lived there ever since' → živi u Milanu.

qs.q:
Pac-Man

"By paying careful attention to themes, design, and colours, they hoped (16) ______." 

A that provide Pac-Man with the temporary ability to eat the enemies
B finally completing a level and moving on to the next maze
C the central character was given the name Pac-Man
D that this arcade game would appeal to women
E when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G that did not emphasize violence
opts: A — that provide Pac-Man with ability to eat enemies
C — the central character was named Pac-Man
D — that this arcade game would appeal to women
E — when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F — which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G — that did not emphasize violence
qs.exp: 'They hoped (16)____.' → D: that this arcade game would appeal to women. Namco je htio napraviti igru koja bi privukla žene (tematikom hrane, bez nasilja).

qs.q:
Pac-Man

"The players moved through a simple maze with a joystick, eating coloured dots until all were gone, (17) ______." 

A that provide Pac-Man with the temporary ability to eat the enemies
B finally completing a level and moving on to the next maze
C the central character was given the name Pac-Man
D that this arcade game would appeal to women
E when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G that did not emphasize violence
opts: A — that provide Pac-Man with ability to eat enemies
C — the central character was named Pac-Man
D — that this arcade game would appeal to women
E — when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F — which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G — that did not emphasize violence
qs.exp: 'Eating dots until all were gone, (17)____.' → B: finally completing a level and moving on to the next maze. Logičan nastavak — kad pojede sve točkice, razina je gotova.

qs.q:
Pac-Man

"In Japanese slang, paku paku describes the snapping of a mouth open and shut, so (18) ______." 

A that provide Pac-Man with the temporary ability to eat the enemies
B finally completing a level and moving on to the next maze
C the central character was given the name Pac-Man
D that this arcade game would appeal to women
E when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G that did not emphasize violence
opts: A — that provide Pac-Man with ability to eat enemies
C — the central character was given the name Pac-Man
D — that this arcade game would appeal to women
E — when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F — which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G — that did not emphasize violence
qs.exp: 'Paku paku = zvuk otvaranja/zatvaranja usta, SO (18)____.' → C: the central character was given the name Pac-Man. Ime dolazi od zvuka jela.

qs.q:
Pac-Man

"A group of four enemies, on each level, (19) ______, make the game challenging." 

A that provide Pac-Man with the temporary ability to eat the enemies
B finally completing a level and moving on to the next maze
C the central character was given the name Pac-Man
D that this arcade game would appeal to women
E when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G that did not emphasize violence
opts: A — that provide Pac-Man with ability to eat enemies
C — the central character was given the name Pac-Man
D — that this arcade game would appeal to women
E — when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F — which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G — that did not emphasize violence
qs.exp: 'A group of four enemies, (19)____., make the game challenging.' → F: which try to catch and consume Pac-Man. Relativna surečenica opisuje neprijatelje.

qs.q:
Pac-Man

"The roles of predator and prey are temporarily switched (20) ______." 

A that provide Pac-Man with the temporary ability to eat the enemies
B finally completing a level and moving on to the next maze
C the central character was given the name Pac-Man
D that this arcade game would appeal to women
E when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G that did not emphasize violence
opts: A — that provide Pac-Man with ability to eat enemies
C — the central character was given the name Pac-Man
D — that this arcade game would appeal to women
E — when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'
F — which try to catch and consume Pac-Man
G — that did not emphasize violence
qs.exp: 'Roles switched (20)____.' → E: when Pac-Man eats the special 'power pills'. Uloge se mijenjaju kad Pac-Man pojede power pills.

qs.q:
Anne's letter

"They're always (21) ___ pleasure to receive."

A the
B Ø
C a
qs.exp: 'Always A pleasure to receive' — neodređeni član 'a' uz imenicu 'pleasure' u ovom kontekstu.

qs.q:
Anne's letter

"You really know how to cheer me (22) ______."

A up
B by
C on
qs.exp: 'Cheer someone UP' — fiksni frazalni glagol: cheer up = razveseliti.

qs.q:
Anne's letter

"You asked me (23) ___ I had spent the summer."

A when
B how
C if
qs.exp: 'You asked me HOW I had spent the summer' — neizravno pitanje o načinu provedbe ljeta (how = kako).

qs.q:
Anne's letter

"I caught a cold and was sick for two weeks. Because of this, I (24) ___ go to the youth camp."

A shouldn't
B wouldn't
C couldn't
qs.exp: 'COULDN'T go to the youth camp' — modalni glagol nemogućnosti u prošlosti. Bila je bolesna pa fizički nije mogla ići.

qs.q:
Anne's letter

"How is your new dog? Has she got (25) ___ to you?"

A using
B used
C use
qs.exp: 'Has she got USED to you?' — 'get used to' = naviknuti se na. Struktura: get + used to + noun/pronoun.

qs.q:
The Lady of the Lake

"She warned (26) ___ that she would leave forever if he stepped on her toes three times."

Upiši jednu ili dvije riječi (him / Gwyn).
qs.exp: 'She warned HIM/GWYN' — osobna zamjenica u objektnom padežu ili ime mladog farmera.

qs.q:
The Lady of the Lake

"They lived happily (27) ___ many years and had three sons."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'Lived happily FOR many years' — prijedlog 'for' uz vremenski period.

qs.q:
The Lady of the Lake

"When Gwyn stepped on her toe accidentally for the third time she disappeared into the lake and he (28) ___ saw her again."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'He NEVER saw her again' — prilog 'never' za negaciju bez 'not'.

qs.q:
The Lady of the Lake

"She would sometimes re-appear to her sons and teach them the powers (29) ___ healing herbs and plants."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'The powers OF healing herbs' — fiksni prijedlog: 'the power/powers of something'.

qs.q:
The Lady of the Lake

"They became skilful physicians, as (30) ___ their children after them."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'As DID their children after them' — glagolski operator 'did' u komparativnoj strukturi (kao što su i njihova djeca).

qs.q:
Read the message from Moira:

"Hi
I've started taking cooking classes and I can already prepare a few meals on my own.
What's your favourite food and why?
When and where did you last eat out?
What's your most important meal of the day and why?
Moira"

Write Moira a reply. Answer all her questions. Write 50–70 words.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) omiljena hrana i zašto, (2) kada i gdje si zadnji put jeo/la vani, (3) najvažniji obrok dana i zašto. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi).

qs.q:
You will hear five phone messages.
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

A — Don't give me away.
B — Do something now.
C — Give me a chance.
D — Stay away from it.
E — Keep in touch.
F — Don't leave.
qs.exp: Prema službenom ključu: 1=E, 2=D, 3=B, 4=F, 5=A.

qs.q:
You hear a couple on a driving holiday in England.
How long is it to the next destination?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q6 = B (About ten miles).

qs.q:
You hear Frank talking to his mother on the phone.
What is the password for his computer?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q7 = A (LUCY2JA).

qs.q:
You hear Jeremy talking to his friend.
What time does Jeremy have to be at college?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q8 = C (10:30).

qs.q:
You hear two friends planning a trip to Edinburgh.
How will they go there?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q9 = C (By train).

qs.q:
You hear Jackie leaving a voice message to her friend.
Where will they meet?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q10 = B (At the cinema).

qs.q:
You hear a radio interview with Anna Pratt about writing.

What kind of books did Anna like to read most as a child?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q11 = B (Biographies / biografije).

qs.q: Who did Anna share her first stories with?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q12 = C (No one / nitko).

qs.q: What is Anna's new book about?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q13 = C (Her travels / njezina putovanja).

qs.q: What advice does Anna give beginner writers?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q14 = A (Write your story).

qs.q: What is the next thing Anna will do?
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q15 = B (Give a talk / predavanje).

qs.q:
You hear a teacher talking to students about a visit to Brighton.

The students have to be in Brighton at…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q16 = B (9:50).

qs.q: In the aquarium, the students will be able to get a guide book…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q17 = A (for half the price / za pola cijene).

qs.q: After their visit to Sea World the students will first go to…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q18 = B (the city centre).

qs.q: In their free time in the city centre the teacher recommends that they…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q19 = C (have a meal / objed).

qs.q: The group plans to leave Brighton at 5:00 because of…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q20 = A (the students).

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. About this evening. I've got a lot of work to do, so you'll just have to go without me. Enjoy.
2. I'm so sorry to hear you're leaving. Can't you possibly stay? I'll miss you terribly. You're simply the best.
3. You have to see the Batman movie. It's only on for a few more days, and you'll be sorry if you don't see it.
4. I know it hurts that you broke up with Dan, but you shouldn't feel bad about it. I'm sure it was for the best.
5. Hi. Here's the essay I promised you. It's not perfect, I know, but I tried really hard and I couldn't write anything better.
items: 1 — I've got a lot of work to do, you'll have to go without me.
2 — Can't you possibly stay? I'll miss you terribly.
3 — You have to see the Batman movie, it's only on a few more days.
4 — You shouldn't feel bad about breaking up with Dan.
5 — Here's the essay. It's not perfect but it's the best I could do.
rights: B — It's the best I could do.

pairs.l: 1 — I've got a lot of work to do, you'll have to go without me.
2 — Can't you possibly stay? I'll miss you terribly.
3 — You have to see the Batman movie, it's only on a few more days.
4 — You shouldn't feel bad about breaking up with Dan.
5 — Here's the essay. It's not perfect but it's the best I could do.
pairs.r: B — It's the best I could do.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (ne mogu doći, imam puno posla) = E (I'm not coming). Poruka 2 (ne odlazi, faliti ćeš mi) = D (Don't go). Poruka 3 (moraš vidjeti taj film, još ga prikazuju samo nekoliko dana) = F (Don't miss it). Poruka 4 (ne trebaš se osjećati loše zbog raskida) = A (Don't be sorry). Poruka 5 (esej nije savršen, ali je to sve što sam mogao/la) = B (It's the best I could do).

qs.q:
What does Serena say about her new neighbour?

"Have you seen my new neighbour? The minute I saw him I thought he was really attractive. I think he's interested in art like me. So we already have something in common. I also find it easy to talk to him because he's so relaxed."

A He's interesting.
B He's good-looking.
C He's talkative.
qs.exp: Serena kaže 'I thought he was really attractive' → zgodan/dobar izgled = B (good-looking).

qs.q:
Where will Noah spend the evening?

"I was wondering if you'd like to come over to my place after school today. A couple of friends will be there and a guy from the flat upstairs. We sometimes hang out there because he's got this amazing home cinema. And I've ordered in some food for dinner from a nice Chinese restaurant just a block away."

A At home.
B At a neighbour's flat.
C At a restaurant.
qs.exp: Noah kaže 'come over to MY PLACE' i 'a couple of friends will be there' → bit će kod kuće (A). Komšija dolazi k njemu, ne on k komšiji.

qs.q:
Why won't Layla wear her new sweater?

"My aunt has bought me the weirdest sweater you can imagine. At first it seemed the right size. Then I tried it on and I realised it was only big enough for my baby sister, not me."

A It's too big.
B It's too small.
C It's unusual.
qs.exp: 'Big enough for my baby sister, not me' → preveliko za bebu, premaleno za Laylu = B (too small za nju).

qs.q:
Why did David buy a tablet?

"I've finally bought a tablet! So now I'm able to keep in touch with all my friends wherever I am. I can download movies on it, though personally I think the screen's too small for that. As for reading, for me nothing can replace holding a proper book in my hands."

A To contact people.
B To watch films.
C To read.
qs.exp: 'Now I'm able to KEEP IN TOUCH with all my friends wherever I am' → razlog kupnje je kontakt s prijateljima = A.

qs.q:
What does Liam recommend?

"Last night I went to the restaurant you'd told me about. I tried the prawn cocktail as you'd recommended and it was excellent. The mushroom soup was a bit disappointing. However, I have never tasted such delicious seafood risotto. You should try it the next time you go there."

A The soup.
B The prawns.
C The risotto.
qs.exp: Liam kaže 'I have never tasted such delicious seafood risotto. You should try it' → preporučuje risotto = C.

qs.q:
Scott Flansburg – the maths genius

"It was after his appearance on Regis Philbin's talk show that he became known as the 'Human Calculator'."

Question 11: What is Scott Flansburg's nickname?
qs.exp: Tekst kaže 'he became known as the Human Calculator' → nadimak je Human Calculator.

qs.q:
Scott Flansburg – the maths genius

"It all started 40 years ago when, at the age of nine, he discovered his remarkable ability."

Question 12: How old is Scott Flansburg now? (Write a number)
qs.exp: Sposobnost je otkrio sa 9 godina, a to je bilo prije 40 godina → sada ima 9 + 40 = 49 godina.

qs.q:
Scott Flansburg – the maths genius

"He is an edutainer, a person who educates and entertains at the same time."

Question 13: What is Scott Flansburg's occupation?
qs.exp: Tekst eksplicitno kaže 'He is an edutainer, a person who educates and entertains'.

qs.q:
Scott Flansburg – the maths genius

"Everybody in his hometown in Canada thought that he would become a maths teacher."

Question 14: What is Scott Flansburg's country of origin?
qs.exp: 'His hometown in Canada' → Scott je iz Kanade.

qs.q:
Scott Flansburg – the maths genius

"He is also the author of Math Magic for Kids and Math Magic."

Question 15: How many books has Scott Flansburg written?
qs.exp: Napisao je dvije knjige: Math Magic for Kids i Math Magic → 2.

qs.q:
Lipreading

"It's invisible and doesn't change the way you appear to other people, (16) ______." 

A they can be understood
B but it also improves self-confidence
C but it does the way you feel
D they become active in everyday communication
E its rewards are immense
F other strategies have to be used
G when trying to communicate
opts: B — but it also improves self-confidence
C — but it does the way you feel
D — they become active in everyday communication
F — other strategies have to be used
qs.exp: 'Doesn't change the way you APPEAR, (16)____.' → C: but it does the way you FEEL (ali mijenja način na koji se osjećaš). Kontrast između vanjskog izgleda i unutarnjeg osjećaja.

qs.q:
Lipreading

"Learning to lipread not only helps with communication, (17) ______." 

A they can be understood
B but it also improves self-confidence
C but it does the way you feel
D they become active in everyday communication
E its rewards are immense
F other strategies have to be used
G when trying to communicate
opts: B — but it also improves self-confidence
C — but it does the way you feel
D — they become active in everyday communication
F — other strategies have to be used
qs.exp: 'Not only helps with communication, (17)____.' → B: but it also improves self-confidence. Struktura 'not only... but also'.

qs.q:
Lipreading

"Once they develop their lipreading skills, (18) ______." 

A they can be understood
B but it also improves self-confidence
C but it does the way you feel
D they become active in everyday communication
E its rewards are immense
F other strategies have to be used
G when trying to communicate
opts: B — but it also improves self-confidence
C — but it does the way you feel
D — they become active in everyday communication
F — other strategies have to be used
qs.exp: 'Once they develop their skills, (18)____. Taking part in conversations they used to avoid is not impossible any more.' → D: they become active in everyday communication.

qs.q:
Lipreading

"Since some people talk very fast, or mumble, or cover their mouths when they speak, (19) ______." 

A they can be understood
B but it also improves self-confidence
C but it does the way you feel
D they become active in everyday communication
E its rewards are immense
F other strategies have to be used
G when trying to communicate
opts: B — but it also improves self-confidence
C — but it does the way you feel
D — they become active in everyday communication
F — other strategies have to be used
qs.exp: 'Since some people mumble or cover mouths, (19)____. Everybody uses facial expressions and body language.' → F: other strategies have to be used (trebaju se koristiti druge strategije).

qs.q:
Lipreading

"Although learning to lipread takes time, patience and understanding, (20) ______." 

A they can be understood
B but it also improves self-confidence
C but it does the way you feel
D they become active in everyday communication
E its rewards are immense
F other strategies have to be used
G when trying to communicate
opts: B — but it also improves self-confidence
C — but it does the way you feel
D — they become active in everyday communication
F — other strategies have to be used
qs.exp: 'Although it takes time and patience, (20)____.' → E: its rewards are immense (nagrade su ogromne). Kontrast s 'although'.

qs.q:
Keira's email

"We (21) ___ together for a month, so it was a kind of anniversary."

A are
B have been
C were
qs.exp: 'We HAVE BEEN together for a month' — present perfect za radnju koja je počela u prošlosti i traje do sadašnjosti (for + period).

qs.q:
Keira's email

"I had a few things to do before I (22) ___ leave home, like washing my hair and choosing my clothes."

A am able to
B can
C could
qs.exp: 'Before I COULD leave home' — modalni glagol 'could' u prošlosti (was able to). Kontekst je narativ o prošlim događajima.

qs.q:
Keira's email

"I had a few things to do... like washing my hair and choosing my clothes, (23) ___ took me longer than I expected."

A which
B that
C what
qs.exp: '..., WHICH took me longer' — relativna zamjenica 'which' za ne-restriktivnu relativnu surečenicu (uz zarez).

qs.q:
Keira's email

"As a result, I left home late, (24) ___ I had to hurry."

A when
B so
C because
qs.exp: 'I left late, SO I had to hurry' — 'so' izražava posljedicu (therefore/as a result).

qs.q:
Keira's email

"My shoes don't (25) ___ me properly and soon my feet were hurting."

A suit
B match
C fit
qs.exp: 'Shoes don't FIT me' = cipele mi ne odgovaraju po veličini/obliku. 'Fit' = odgovarati (o odjeći/obući). 'Suit' = pristajati (stilu), 'match' = slagati se bojom.

qs.q:
Daisy's letter

"I'm pleased to hear that you (26) ___ made loads of new friends at college."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'You HAVE made loads of new friends' — present perfect: have + past participle.

qs.q:
Daisy's letter

"Patrick sounds nice. I'd like to meet (27) ___."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'I'd like to meet HIM' — osobna zamjenica u objektnom padežu za muški rod (Patrick = him).

qs.q:
Daisy's letter

"I was wondering (28) ___ you'd like to come down and spend a few days with me."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'I was wondering IF/WHETHER you'd like to come' — neizravno pitanje s 'if' ili 'whether'.

qs.q:
Daisy's letter

"How (29) ___ bringing Patrick with you?"

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'How ABOUT bringing Patrick?' — fiksni izraz za prijedlog/sugestiju: 'How about + gerund'.

qs.q:
Daisy's letter

"I'm really looking (30) ___ to seeing you."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'Looking FORWARD to seeing you' — fiksni izraz: look forward to + gerund.

qs.q:
Read the message from Sarah:

"Hi,
Hooray! Summer is finally here! It is my favourite season. I have so many plans!
What did you do last summer? Where would you like to spend your ideal holiday and why? Who would you like to go there with and why?
Love, Sarah"

Write Sarah a reply. Answer all her questions. Write 50–70 words.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) što si radio/la prošlog ljeta, (2) gdje bi htio/la provesti idealni odmor i zašto, (3) s kim bi htio/la ići i zašto. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi).

qs.q:
You will hear five phone messages.
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. I'm interested in your research. Can you tell me more about your results? [G = It is interesting.]
1. The date was fine but he has no interest in seeing her again. He doesn't find her interesting enough.
2. She says the movie does not interest her that much. She doesn't feel like going.
3. I talked to him and he'd like to hear more about her project.
4. We've already seen his show four times. I don't know how you can still be interested in watching him for the fifth time.
5. We feel there's more to her than we think. We're interested in getting to know her better.
items: 1 — He has no interest in seeing her again.
2 — She doesn't feel like going to the movie.
3 — He'd like to hear more about her project.
4 — I don't know how you can still be interested in him.
5 — We're interested in getting to know her better.

pairs.l: 1 — He has no interest in seeing her again.
2 — She doesn't feel like going to the movie.
3 — He'd like to hear more about her project.
4 — I don't know how you can still be interested in him.
5 — We're interested in getting to know her better.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (on ne nalazi je dovoljno zanimljivom) = E (She doesn't interest him). Poruka 2 (njoj se ne da gledati film) = F (She's not interested). Poruka 3 (on bi htio čuti više o njezinom projektu) = A (He is interested). Poruka 4 (on ih ne zanima više) = C (He doesn't interest them). Poruka 5 (zanimljiva nam je, hoćemo je bolje upoznati) = D (She's interesting).

qs.q:
How much did Julie pay for her bag?

"Remember that red bag we saw the other day for £70? Today I was window shopping and saw the same one for £20 less. It was mine right away. There was a wonderful yellow one, too for only £60, but it was too much!"

A £20.
B £50.
C £60.
qs.exp: Torba je bila £70, Julie ju je kupila za £20 manje → £70 − £20 = £50 (B).

qs.q:
How does Cathy feel about the book she has read?

"I have finally read the final chapters of the novel. It's nothing like the movie, which was boring and didn't impress me at all. I can't say I was surprised about the end, but still, I have to wear sunglasses because I've been crying all night. I've never been so affected by written words in my life."

A Disappointed.
B Surprised.
C Moved.
qs.exp: Cathy plače cijelu noć i kaže 'I've never been so affected by written words' → dirnuta/ganuta = Moved (C).

qs.q:
What does John think of his new job?

"I've been a month in my new job. I feel good because there is no pressure whatsoever. My paycheck is great, which makes my life easier. But I wish my boss would give me more challenging tasks or I'll be bored soon."

A It's demanding.
B It's well paid.
C It's motivating.
qs.exp: John kaže 'My paycheck is great' → posao je dobro plaćen (B = well paid). Nije naporan niti motivirajući — zapravo mu nedostaje izazova.

qs.q:
What does Tina think of the book she read?

"It's about boys on an island with no adults. At first they are just bored but then they start fighting. It didn't take them long to forget about civilisation. It is really a presentation of human nature. At times I had to stop reading because I couldn't believe what the boys were doing."

A It is boring.
B It is long.
C It is shocking.
qs.exp: Tina kaže 'I had to stop reading because I couldn't believe what the boys were doing' → šokantno (C = shocking).

qs.q:
What is Simona like?

"Ever since we were kids you have known what you wanted. You were amazed by everything you learnt about the human body. You've always trusted your own skills and that is why this reward for Doctor of the Year comes as no surprise."

A Confident.
B Trusting.
C Open-minded.
qs.exp: 'You've always trusted your own skills' = uvijek je vjerovala u sebe → sigurna u sebe = Confident (A).

qs.q:
Across the water, but a world away!

"There is an island that lies off the state of South Australia."

Question 11: What is the official name of the island?

qs.q:
Across the water, but a world away!

"Island Beach, also known as Millionaire's Row, is the most charming beach on Ki, as the locals call the island."

qs.exp: 'As the locals call the island' → lokalni naziv je Ki.

"The island was mapped by the French explorer Nicolas Baudin after the British explorer Matthew Flinders landed there in 1800."

Question 13: Who discovered (first landed on) the island?

Across the water, but a world away!

"The one that is likely to impress you, and the most massive, is of course the famous grey kangaroo."

qs.q:

"For those who are brave enough, sandboarding is an ideal choice."

qs.q:
The story of Doctor Dolittle

"Dolittle is an English gentleman who (16) ____." 

A seem new and marvellous
B is right there in front of us all
C has its own secret language
D finds himself in the wrong occupation
E gather all the animals that need help
F that animals have a language of their own
G how he came to talk to animals
opts: B — is right there in front of us all
C — has its own secret language
D — finds himself in the wrong occupation
E — gather all the animals that need help
F — that animals have a language of their own
G — how he came to talk to animals
qs.exp: 'Dolittle is an English gentleman who (16)____. He is a doctor of people who gradually withdraws from society.' → D: finds himself in the wrong occupation (u krivom zanimanju). Postaje životinjski liječnik.

qs.q:

A seem new and marvellous
B is right there in front of us all
C has its own secret language
D finds himself in the wrong occupation
E gather all the animals that need help
F that animals have a language of their own
G how he came to talk to animals
opts: B — is right there in front of us all
C — has its own secret language
D — finds himself in the wrong occupation
E — gather all the animals that need help
F — that animals have a language of their own
G — how he came to talk to animals

E gather all the animals that need help
F that animals have a language of their own
G how he came to talk to animals

E — gather all the animals that need help
F — that animals have a language of their own
G — how he came to talk to animals

qs.q:

"For many of us, the (21) ___ important role models are our parents."

A very
B most
C best
qs.exp: 'The MOST important role models' — superlativ pridjeva 'important': the most important.

qs.q:

"We all look up to a variety of people to help shape how we behave in school, form relationships or when (22) ___ difficult decisions."

A making
B doing
C bringing
qs.exp: 'Making difficult decisions' — fiksna kolokacija: make a decision.

qs.q:
Children and role models

"Some parents may want to help their children choose a person to serve (23) ___ a positive role model."

A for
B on
C as
qs.exp: 'Serve AS a role model' = služiti kao uzor. Fiksna kolokacija: serve as.

qs.q:
Children and role models

"Negative role models, (24) ___, may also influence children."

A despite
B however
C contrary
qs.exp: 'HOWEVER' = međutim — diskurzivni veznik koji uvodi kontrast (pozitivni vs. negativni uzori).

qs.q:
Children and role models

"Parents should ask their children what they think of (25) ___ hero's actions."

A they're
B there
C their

qs.q:
Style tips

"Experts say that (26) ___ takes just a blink of an eye to make a first impression."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'IT takes just a blink of an eye' — bespersonalno 'it' kao formalni subjekt.

qs.q:
Style tips

"A (27) ___ seconds are all that is needed to make or break that job interview."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'A FEW seconds' = nekoliko sekundi. 'A few' uz brojive imenice u množini.

qs.q:
Style tips

"This means the clothes you choose (28) ___ wear on these occasions are everything."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'The clothes you choose TO wear' — infinitiv nakon 'choose': choose to do something.

qs.q:
Style tips

"The trick (29) ___ looking beyond clothes that are simply fashionable."

Upiši jednu ili dvije riječi.
qs.exp: 'The trick IS (in) looking beyond fashionable clothes' — glagol 'be' ili prijedlog 'in' + gerund.

qs.q:
Style tips

"Men and women of all different shapes and sizes should look amazing (30) ___ a daily basis."

Upiši jednu riječ.
qs.exp: 'ON a daily basis' = na dnevnoj bazi. Fiksni izraz: on a ... basis.

qs.q:
Read the message from Sarah:

"Hi!
It was my birthday yesterday and we had a wonderful time.
How was your last birthday and what did you do? Whose present did you like best and why?
What are your plans for your next birthday?
Sarah"

Write Sarah a reply. Answer all her questions. Write 50–70 words.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kako je prošao zadnji rođendan i što si radio/la, (2) čiji je poklon bio najbolji i zašto, (3) planovi za sljedeći rođendan. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi).

qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. What a nice dress! It really looks good on you. [G = I'm impressed.]
1. I still can't believe the price of that book I bought. I really didn't expect it to be so expensive.
2. Mark wasn't at school this morning. He's cutting classes again. What's wrong with him?
3. I am sorry but I can't stop crying. It is the best present ever!
4. I would be happy to go to the concert but I have to study for the exam. Please excuse me.
5. I was surprised by the offer and I still don't know how to decide between the two cars.
items: 1 — I can't believe the price of that book.
2 — Mark wasn't at school. What's wrong with him?
3 — I can't stop crying. The best present ever!
4 — I'd go to the concert but I have to study.
5 — I was surprised and don't know how to decide.

pairs.l: 1 — I can't believe the price of that book.
2 — Mark wasn't at school. What's wrong with him?
3 — I can't stop crying. The best present ever!
4 — I'd go to the concert but I have to study.
5 — I was surprised and don't know how to decide.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (šokiran cijenom knjige) = F (iznenađen). Poruka 2 (zabrinut za Marka koji bježi s nastave) = E (zabrinut). Poruka 3 (plače od sreće zbog poklona) = D (sretan). Poruka 4 (ne može na koncert zbog ispita, žao mu je) = A (žao mi je). Poruka 5 (iznenađen ponudom, ne zna se odlučiti) = B (zbunjen).

qs.q:
Which show are the tickets booked for?

"Dear Flora, Good news! I got the tickets. I tried to book the tickets for the ten o'clock show but it was sold out. You know that John can't leave the office before 8, so I managed to get three for the 9 o'clock show. Is that okay? Jack"

A The 8 o'clock show.
B The 9 o'clock show.
C The 10 o'clock show.
qs.exp: Jack kaže 'managed to get three for the 9 o'clock show' → karte su za 9 sati (B). Željeni termin od 10 h bio je rasprodan.

qs.q:
How does Rose feel about Frank's birthday?

"I want to make a cake for Frank's birthday but I've lost your recipe. His parents are going to be there and now I'm certain our relationship is serious. Scary, hah! I know I should be nervous about the whole thing but I can't wait for tomorrow."

A Nervous.
B Afraid.
C Excited.
qs.exp: Rose kaže 'I can't wait for tomorrow' — jedva čeka, što znači da je uzbuđena (C = Excited). Govori da bi 'trebala' biti nervozna, ali nije.

qs.q:
Where is Mary going to meet her friend?

"Fancy meeting in town? I need to buy some groceries at the corner shop where we met last time. I'll be waiting for you with a cup of coffee at the new place next to Johnny's dry cleaner's, where I have to pick up my coat."

A At the grocer's.
B At the dry cleaner's.
C At the coffee shop.
qs.exp: Mary kaže 'I'll be WAITING for you with a cup of coffee at the new place' → sastanak je u kafeu (C). Trgovina i kemijska čistionica su drugi razlozi odlaska u grad.

qs.q:
What does Sybille think of her new mobile phone?

"My mum surprised me with a new mobile phone. It's not as light as my old one, but it looks much better. It has a bigger screen which makes everything easier. What's more, it was a real bargain."

A It's expensive.
B It's user-friendly.
C It's very light.
qs.exp: 'A bigger screen which makes everything easier' → lako se koristi, user-friendly (B). Nije lagana (A) ni skupa — bila je bargain.

qs.q:
What would Mia like?

"You know it's my birthday soon. I guess I'll have to fake my surprise again when mum throws me a party. An intimate gathering of family members, as she calls it. If only she would invite my friends over too. That would spice up the evening. Wouldn't it be a blast!"

A A surprise party.
B An intimate party.
C An exciting party.
qs.exp: Mia želi da dođi i prijatelji — 'That would spice up the evening. Wouldn't it be a blast!' → želi uzbudljivu (exciting) zabavu (C).

qs.q:
Gold Coast whale watching

"During whale season Sea World whale watching tours depart once a day at 10am. Check-in time is at least thirty minutes before tour departure time. Allow at least three hours per tour."

Question 11: What is the minimum duration of the tour?
qs.exp: Tekst kaže 'Allow at least three hours per tour' → minimalna dužina je 3 sata.

qs.q:
Gold Coast whale watching

"Have a look at our ticket prices. Entry to the exciting water park is not included but separate tickets may be purchased."

Question 12: For what do you need to pay extra?
qs.exp: 'Entry to the exciting water park is not included' → za ulazak u aquapark treba se platiti posebno.

qs.q:
Gold Coast whale watching — Ticket prices:
Adult $99 / Online $89
Child (3-13) $77 / Online $67
Students $85 / Online $80

Question 13: How can you save money on tickets?
qs.exp: Online cijene su jeftinije (npr. $99 → $89 za odrasle) → rezervacijom online/unaprijed štediš novac.

qs.q:
Gold Coast whale watching

"You can also experience the unique feeling of tracking the whales from the Captain's Lounge, with a perfect view in the heart of the ship's command center completely free of charge. It only fits up to four people comfortably, so parties of five or more will have to split up."

Question 14: What is the capacity of the Captain's Lounge?
qs.exp: 'It only fits up to four people comfortably' → kapacitet je 4 osobe.

qs.q:
Gold Coast whale watching

"We will give you your money back if there is no sighting of whales during the tour. However, there is no refund in case of bad weather."

Question 15: In which case will you get a refund?
qs.exp: 'Money back if there is no sighting of whales' → povrat novca ako se kitovi ne vide.

qs.q:

A telling a white lie at least once
B having a problem
C and to avoid punishment
D to understand the use and power of language
E have a problem
F testing social rules
G 'omits the truth'
opts: A — telling a white lie at least once
D — to understand the use and power of language

B having a problem
C and to avoid punishment
D to understand the use and power of language

G 'omits the truth'
opts: A — telling a white lie at least once
D — to understand the use and power of language

qs.q:

A telling a white lie at least once
B having a problem
C and to avoid punishment
D to understand the use and power of language

F testing social rules
G 'omits the truth'

D — to understand the use and power of language

qs.q:

"They lie to protect themselves, to look good, to gain financially or socially (19) ____."

B having a problem
C and to avoid punishment
D to understand the use and power of language

F testing social rules
G 'omits the truth'
opts: A — telling a white lie at least once

qs.q:
Lies

"It is very difficult to help them as they deny (20) ____." 

A telling a white lie at least once
B having a problem
C and to avoid punishment
D to understand the use and power of language
E have a problem
F testing social rules

qs.q:

"Dear Ms Geller, I have to tell you that I cannot be your dog walker any more. Although I like your dog a lot, I can't deal with his tiresome disobedience. He simply needs too much attention and making him happy is a mission impossible."

A Annoyed.
B Needy.
C Tired.
qs.exp: Jana koristi riječ 'tiresome disobedience' i 'mission impossible' — frustrirana je i iznervirana ponašanjem psa → Annoyed (A).

qs.q:
What did Berry like most about the film?

"I was so enthusiastic about going to the cinema to watch my first film in 3D, and I really enjoyed it. The technology definitely gave a special dimension to the movie. I know it was the script that got the film its fully deserved award. Though, what truly impressed me was the music."

A The movie soundtrack.
B The special effects.
C The original screenplay.
qs.exp: Berry kaže 'what truly impressed me was the music' → glazba (A = movie soundtrack). 3D tehnologija je bila posebna, a scenarij je zaslužio nagradu, ali glazba je najviše impresionirala.

qs.q:
What does Timothy want to do on Saturday?

"There's an exhibition of James Bond vehicles at the National Motor Museum in Hampshire on Saturday, so what do you think? I bet you've never been there. It would be interesting to drive down from London. I'm really not up to another weekend in the city."

A Drive around in a James Bond car.
B Spend it outside of London.
C Watch a movie at a cinema.
opts: Drive around in a James Bond car.
Watch a movie at a cinema.
qs.exp: Timothy kaže 'I'm really not up to another weekend in the city' i predlaže odlazak u Hampshire → želi provesti vikend izvan Londona (B).

qs.q:
What was Susan's experience like?

"I'm finally back! You'd think I'd have learned something new, right? Nope. The guide made a few bad jokes and we all ignored him till the end. But the climb – wow! It was really hard work! I had to use all my strength to get to the top! But it was worth it – the view was amazing!"

A Educational.
B Great fun.
C Rewarding.
qs.exp: Susan kaže 'it was worth it' i 'the view was amazing' — naporno, ali isplatilo se → Rewarding (C). Nije bilo obrazovno (vodič loš), niti 'great fun'.

qs.q:
How much does Mrs Anderson have to pay?

"Your e-invoice is attached. Please note that the total amount of £50 was reduced by £10 because of your loyalty membership. You also benefit from a further discount of £5 as a regular buyer. Your order is ready to be shipped as soon as we receive payment."

A £35.
B £40.
C £50.
qs.exp: £50 − £10 (loyalty) − £5 (regular buyer) = £35 → A.

qs.q:
A Poet's Life

Lillian Parkin was born in 1941 in Coventry to a postman and his stay-at-home wife. Parkin graduated from Oxford University with first class honours in English Literature. She considered doing doctoral studies, but for financial reasons, ended up in journalism, and then became a schoolteacher in Ipswich.

Question 11: What was Lillian Parkin's father's profession?
qs.exp: Tekst kaže 'born in 1941 in Coventry to a postman and his stay-at-home wife' → otac je bio postman (poštaš).

qs.q:
A Poet's Life

Parkin graduated from Oxford University with first class honours in English Literature.

Question 12: What did Lillian Parkin study at university? (Write the subject)
qs.exp: Tekst eksplicitno kaže 'first class honours in English Literature'.

qs.q:
A Poet's Life

Her first collection, Dark Magic, came out in 1966 to immediate praise. The original title had been Light Magic but she changed it on the recommendation of her then husband, the poet Ted Duhig.

Question 13: What was the title of Lillian Parkin's first poetry collection?
qs.exp: Tekst kaže 'Her first collection, Dark Magic, came out in 1966' → Dark Magic.

qs.q:
A Poet's Life

Seven more collections followed, including So What?, which was nominated for the National Prize, and, in 1982, Who's Next?, which won the Whitbread Prize.

Question 14: Which prize did Lillian Parkin win? (Write the name of the prize)
qs.exp: Tekst kaže 'Who's Next?, which won the Whitbread Prize' → Whitbread (Prize).

qs.q:
A Poet's Life

In 1986 she moved to Cornwall, 'tired of life in the great city,' as she recorded in one of her many memoirs. She lives there with her third husband, their six cats, two parrots, and a tarantula called Neil.

Question 15: Where does Lillian Parkin currently live?
qs.exp: Tekst kaže 'In 1986 she moved to Cornwall... She lives there' → Cornwall.

Upiši jednu ili dvije riječi (this / the).

"Then water is poured over the stone so the parts of the stone (29) ___ are not protected with the greasy paint soak up the water."

How stone lithography works

"The greasy parts of the stone pick up the ink, while the wet parts (30) ___ not."

Upiši jednu riječ.

"Dear Sir, I have been your customer for the last five years. I have always been very happy with the products in your store and the assistance. I do not mind the fact that you recently moved the store out of the town. I must say, though, that the last time I went there your new shop assistant was not very helpful."
qs.exp: Thomas kaže da je bio zadovoljan svim osim novog prodavača koji nije bio od pomoći → žali se na uslugu (service).

qs.q:
Where did Marion go shopping in Rome?

"I decided to go to ANNA's, a new department store with the world's most fashionable boutiques. It's huge. Although it looked like it was only for the rich and famous, I found some real bargains there. It's the biggest store I've ever visited."
qs.exp: Marion kaže 'the world's most fashionable boutiques' → C (najtrendovskija). Bila je nova i najveća, ali fashionable je ono što je privuklo Marion.

qs.q:
What does Neil say in his message?

"Hello everyone, there is going to be a great concert in the music club. The Big Guys are coming to play on Saturday night. Let me know if you want tickets as soon as possible. I can get them for you at a discount. After all, I'm a member of the club!"
opts: He invites everyone to join the club.
He offers to buy cheaper tickets.
He wants to pay for everyone.
qs.exp: Neil kaže da može nabaviti karte s popustom (at a discount) → nudi jeftinije karte (B). Ne plaća za sve, samo može nabaviti uz popust.

qs.q:

"It was a nightmare. The plane was late because we had to wait for a missing passenger. I'd missed my connection to Corsica so I had to wait at the airport for 6 hours. qs.q: Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.

2  There’s no need for you to rewrite the whole essay. I will read it and mark it despite your untidy handwriting.

qs.exp: 1→F (sloboda izostaviti sate, predati jedan rad = možeš), 2→A (nije potrebno prepisivati = ne moraš), 3→C (strogo zabranjeno varanje = ne smiješ), 4→E (savjet: dođi 3 sata ranije = trebalo bi), 5→B (obveza slijediti pravila = moraš). D suvišan.

qs.exp: “I settled for a designer bracelet.” → narukvica = nakit (jewelry). Alice je napomenula pulover, Martha je razmišljala o knjizi, ali odlučila za narukvicu.

qs.q: It ___ us an opportunity to laugh again.

qs.q: ...people ___ laugh easily and find the humour in everyday situations.
qs.exp: Relativna zamjenica za osobe: ‘who’. “People who laugh easily”.

qs.q: Pay attention ___ children and imitate them.
qs.exp: Fiksna kolokacija: “pay attention to” = obraćati pažnju na.

qs.q: ...performed better ___ any of them.
qs.exp: “Better than” = bolje od. Komparativ zahtijeva ‘than’.

qs.q: Frozen ___ earned almost $1.2 billion worldwide.
qs.exp: Present perfect: “Frozen has earned” = Frozen je zaradio (do sada). Prihvatljivo: has.

qs.exp: “In the first month after it came out” = u prvom mjesecu nakon izlaska. Prihvatljivo: after / when.

qs.q: If it ___ just a simple movie without music, kids wouldn’t watch it so many times.
qs.exp: Drugi kondicionalni (unreal present): “If it were—”. Prihvatljivo: were / was.

qs.exp: Pasiv + agent: “played by Kirsten Bell” = glumički portretiran od. ‘By’ za vršitelja radnje u pasivu.

pairs.r: D — because she had gone out with another boy

pairs.l: 17  ...when he saw her at Jade’s party, ___
18  ...she hated the idea ___

pairs.r: F — to be free to see other people

qs.q: ...I was given an old magic set ___ an aunt.
qs.exp: Pasiv s agensom: “given by an aunt” = dobio od tetke. U pasivu koristimo ‘by’ za vršitelja radnje.

qs.q: ...I didn’t have a clue ___ it was for...
qs.exp: “Have a clue what it was for” = znati za što je. Upitna zamjenica ‘what’ uvodi zavisnu upitn.šnicu.

qs.q: ...I would actually earn my living by ___ magic tricks.
qs.exp: “Doing magic tricks” = izvoditi mačionarske trikove. Fiksna kolokacija: ‘do a trick’.

qs.q: That’s why I ___ a lot of money in getting better magic equipment.
qs.exp: “Invest money in” = uložiti novac u nešto. Fiksna kolokacija ‘invest in’.

qs.q: She had died ___ I actually started doing magic professionally.
qs.exp: “She had died before I started” = umrla je prije nego što sam počeo. Past perfect + before.

qs.q: ...just a couple of miles of this road contain more ___ 90,000 magnets...
qs.exp: “More than 90,000” = više od 90.000. Komparativ s ‘more’ zahtijeva ‘than’.

qs.q: ...a magnetic field which is recognised ___ instruments in the bumpers of cars.
qs.exp: “Recognised by instruments” = prepoznaju ga uređaji. Pasiv + agent = ‘by’.

qs.q: The cars travel in a convoy ___ speed is fixed.
qs.exp: “A convoy whose speed is fixed” = konvoj čija je brzina fiksna. Posvojni relativizator ‘whose’. Prihvatljivo: whose / where.

qs.q: They have radio antennas that pick ___ all the necessary driving information...
qs.exp: Frazalni glagol: “pick up information” = primiti/pokupiti informacije.

qs.q: ...'driving' our cars and ___ the same time browsing the internet...
qs.exp: Fiksna fraza: “at the same time” = u isto vrijeme.

"I've joined a fitness club! There are lots of people there trying to lose weight. But there are some who just want to keep in good condition, like me. Fortunately, it's a good atmosphere there, and I'm making new friends."

B To lose weight.
C To stay fit.
qs.exp: 'Just want to KEEP IN GOOD CONDITION, like me' → Sam je pristupio da ostane u formi = C (To stay fit).

"I've got a tattoo on my shoulder now! My parents won't like that. There's a lot they don't like. They don't like loud music, so I use earphones when they're home. They don't like my boyfriend – they say I'm crazy to be with him."

A Her tattoo.
B Her music.
C Her boyfriend.
qs.exp: Roditelju ne sviđaju se tetovaže, glazba i dečko — ali ključni: 'They don't like my BOYFRIEND' → specifični problem = C. Glazbu rješava slušalicama, tetovaža je nova, ali dečko je eksplicitno navedeno 'don't like'.

A A book.
B A CD.
C A DVD.
qs.exp: 'Thanks for the CD' → Isaac je DOBIO (posudio) CD od Edwarda = B. Knjiga je Isaacova (traži je natrag), a DVD tek traži.

qs.q: Chocolate was not just a delicious dessert — it played an important part in the religious and social lives of people living in ancient times. ___
qs.exp: “However” uvodi kontrast: danas smatramo čokoladu slatkim deserom, ali nekad je bila više od toga.

qs.q: They drank it only ___ special occasions.
qs.exp: Fiksna kolokacija: “on special occasions” = za posebne prigode.

qs.q: The Spanish ___ it secret.
qs.exp: “Kept it secret” = čuvali tajnu. ‘Kept secret’ je fiksna kolokacija.

qs.q: Chocolate was known only ___ a drink until the 19th century.
qs.exp: “Known as” = poznat kao. ‘As’ se koristi za ulogu/funkciju.

qs.q: So we should not be surprised ___ the Swiss eat more than 10 kilos of chocolate per person a year.
qs.exp: “Surprised that” = iznenađen činjenicom. Fiksna prepozicijska konstrukcija.

qs.q: ...he saw a light was ___ in his garden shed...
qs.exp: “Light was on” = svjetlo je bilo upaljeno. Idiom: ‘the light is on’.

qs.q: ...the policeman asked him: “Are the burglars in your house?”, to ___ Charlie replied: “No”.
qs.exp: “To which Charlie replied” = na što je Charlie odgovorio. Relativna zamjenica ‘which’ odnosi se na pitanje.

qs.q: He waited a minute and called again. “Hello, I called a minute ___ because of the burglars.”
qs.exp: “A minute ago” = prije minute. ‘Ago’ za prošlosti u odnosu na sadašnjost. Prihvatljivo: ago/earlier.

qs.q: I ___ just shot them.
qs.exp: Present perfect: “I have just shot them” = upravo sam ih ustrijelio. ‘Have’ je pomoćni glagol za present perfect.

qs.q: I thought you said ___ were no patrol cars free!
qs.exp: “There were no patrol cars free” = nije bilo slobodnih patrola. Bezlična egzistencijalna konstrukcija ‘there + be’.

qs.q:
Where will Martin spend the weekend?

Email: "You know how I’ve been looking forward to working on my physics project at Peter’s place this weekend. Well, my mother says I promised to clear out my grandparents’ garage... and now I’m not allowed out."
qs.exp: Martin nije smio izaći iz kuće (“now I’m not allowed out”) → provodi vikend kod kuće.

qs.q:
Why is Lauren going to London?

Email: "I’m so excited I’m going to see my nephew, who’s only three months old. I hope I’ll have some time to see the sights too, because when I’m there at a conference, I usually don’t."
opts: To take part in a conference.
qs.exp: Lauren ide vidjeti nećaka (relatives). Konferencija je sekundarna — ali u ovom ispitu NCVVO je svim učenicima dao bod zbog greške u tisku. Prihvatljivi su B i C.
qs.note: Q7 — NCVVO je svim pristupnicima dodijelio bod zbog greške u ispitu (Odluka, 31. svibnja 2011.).

qs.q:
How much did Jack pay for the theatre ticket?

Email: "I finally got my theatre ticket for Giselle. The £6 seats were sold out, and the £10 seats seemed too expensive, so I decided to take one for £8."
qs.exp: Jack odabrao £8 kartu — £6 su rasprodane, £10 preskupe.

qs.q:
What was Martha’s journey like?

Email: "Most people think trains are slow and boring, but I remember how thrilling my first train journey was. So I took the train to the seaside. Well, I had to stand the whole journey and my back was killing me."
qs.exp: Martha je stajala cijeli put i leđa su je ubijala → iscrpljujuće (exhausting). Uzbuđenje je bila njezina prva vožnja — ovaj put nije bila uzbuđena, bila je iscrpljena.

qs.q:
Where did Jim take Coleen out?

Email: "I took Coleen out on our first date on Friday. I had booked a table at a nice Italian restaurant. I was late picking her up because I had to drop in at my cousin’s birthday party, so we ended up seeing a late show instead."
qs.exp: Restoran je bio plan, ali zakasnio je pa su otišli na kasnu projekciju (late show = kino). Nije parti — to je bio usputni posjet rođendanu brata od strica.

qs.q:
What is Martha Meyers’ nationality?

"My parents chose Canada. I grew up speaking French and kept telling people I was French." (Her father worked in Kent, England.)
qs.exp: Martha je rođena u Engleskoj (Kent), ali odrasla u Kanadi govoreći francuski. Ključ prihvaća English ili British.

qs.q:
How old is Martha Meyers?

"How does 25 years of French-Canadian upbringing influence your music?"
qs.exp: 25 godina odrastanja u Kanadi — ali po ključu je odgovor 28 (vjerojatno ima 28 godina u trenutku intervjua; u Kanadu došla s 3 god.).

qs.q:
What is Martha Meyers’ profession?

"She’s just released the album Days of our Lives to stunning reviews."
qs.exp: Martha je pjevačica/glazbenica — prihvatljivo: singer ili musician.

qs.q:
What is Martha’s current hobby?

"My hobbies used to be rollerblading and water skiing. But, lately I’ve substituted water for snow."
qs.exp: ‘Substituted water for snow’ → sada skiča na snijegu umjesto vodenih skija. Odgovor: (snow) skiing.

qs.q:
What is Martha’s favourite instrument?

"My brothers and sisters and I play the violin, guitar, cello, flute, piano. But I always single out the keyboard instrument as my true love."
qs.exp: ‘Keyboard instrument’ = klavir/piano. Martha kaže to je njezina ‘true love’.

qs.q:
Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F). One letter is not needed.

16. Electricians have decorated some of the oldest trees in Britain with hundreds of lights ___.
17. The autumn colour trails regularly attract more than 100,000 daytime visitors, ___.
18. The arboretum, with 4,000 species, is one of the biggest in Europe ___.
19. Peter, the head forester, says that they chose specific trees ___.
20. He thinks we should just let nature do the talking, ___.
rights: A — whose branches create fantastic forms.
B — and is still growing in size.
C — to walk among the red and gold trees.
D — to create the first woodland electric light show.
E — because it’s really got a lot to say.
F — but the idea to light the trees at night came only recently.

pairs.r: D — to create the first woodland electric light show.
F — but the idea to light the trees at night came only recently.
B — and is still growing in size.
A — whose branches create fantastic forms.
E — because it’s really got a lot to say.

qs.exp: 16=D, 17=F, 18=B, 19=A, 20=E prema ključu. C (to walk among red and gold trees) je suvišno.

qs.q: For me, a good friend is somebody I can ___ a good laugh with.
qs.exp: ‘Have a laugh’ = smijati se zajedno. Fiksna kolokacija u engleskom.

qs.q: It’s someone who won’t get me into trouble by ___ everybody what I do or talk about.
qs.exp: ‘Tell somebody something’ = reći nekome nešto. ‘Tell everybody’ — tell se koristi s osobom kao objektom.

qs.q: A person who doesn’t mind if I ___ at them.
qs.exp: Nakon ‘if’ u uvjetnoj rečenici s ‘mind’ → present simple (shout). ‘Don’t mind if I shout’.

qs.q: I suppose it’s got to be someone who accepts me ___ I am.
qs.exp: ‘Accept me as I am’ = prihvatiti me onakvog kakav jesam. ‘As’ uvodi poređenje/način.

qs.q: ...we just forget about it and get ___ as usual.
qs.exp: ‘Get on’ = dobro se slagati / nastaviti dalje. ‘Get on as usual’ = nastaviti kao i obično.

qs.q: Their transformation from ordinary toy to one of the most famous and expensive ones ___ not been a big surprise.
qs.exp: Present perfect s ‘not been’ → ‘has not been’. Jednična imenica (transformation) → has.

qs.q: ___ all started in 1902 when Theodore (Teddy) Roosevelt gave his name to bears made by the German company Steiff.
qs.exp: ‘It all started’ — bezlična zamjenica ‘it’ za početak priče/pričanja.

qs.q: The rare Steiff animals are ___ superb quality which can last through generations.
qs.exp: ‘Of superb quality’ — be of + quality/size/type. Standardna konstrukcija.

qs.q: Nowadays, people are collecting them ___ valuable antiques.
qs.exp: ‘Collect them as antiques’ — ‘as’ opisuje ulogu/status. ‘As’ = u svojstvu.

qs.q: Recently a “teddy girl” was ___ to a rich Japanese for £110,000.
qs.exp: Pasivna konstrukcija: ‘was sold’ = prodana je. Kontekst: aukcija/prodaja.

qs.q: Holly decided to become a doctor because of:
qs.exp: Holly je odlučila postati liječnik zahvaljujući iskustvu s povremenog posla (holiday job), a ne roditeljima ili ocjenama.

qs.q: Holly Green has worked in…
qs.exp: Holly je radila u više zemalja. Zadnja misija bila je u Peruu — jedan od tri ponuđena odgovora (Malawi, Nepal, Peru).

qs.q: In her last job, Holly…
qs.exp: Na zadnjoj misiji Holly se razbolila (became ill). Možda je naučila jezik, sigurno je radila teško, ali ključna činjenica je bolest.

qs.q: Holly has come home…
qs.exp: Holly se vraća kući primarno posjetiti roditelje — ne udati se ni raditi. Idući korak (tečaj) je zasebno od razloga povratka.

qs.q: Next, Holly will…
qs.exp: Holly planira pohađati tečaj (take a course) nakon povratka. Novi posao ili napredovanje dolaze tek kasnije.

qs.q: The Aqua Programme is for…
qs.exp: Aqua Programme je namijenjen svima (all levels) — nije samo za djecu ni samo za starije od 60 godina.

qs.q: Children under 8 have to…
qs.exp: Djeca mlađa od 8 moraju biti s odraslom osobom (be with an adult). Ne moraju nositi naštitše niti dokazivati da znaju plivati.

qs.q: What is the entry charge for a mother and baby?
qs.exp: Ulaznica za majku i bebu košta £4. Nije £3 ni £7 — to su drugi cjenovni razredi na bazi.

qs.q: What time is the swimming pool reserved for diving?
qs.exp: Bazen je rezerviran za skokove od 19:00 do 20:00 (C). Ne 7-8 ujutro ni 17-18 poslijepodne.

qs.q: Where would you go for a sandwich?
qs.exp: Za sendvič treba otići u The Splash Bar (B). Poolside Bar i Dive Inn su drugi punktovi na bazenu.

qs.q:
How often does Matilda go to the shops?

Email: "I always forget something, so I have to go to the shops just about every other day. I should make a list so I need to go only once a week."
qs.exp: ‘Every other day’ = svaki drugi dan = otprilike 3-4 puta tjedno. Jednom tjedno je ono čemu teži, ali još ne radi.

qs.q:
Why isn’t Bethany going to the party?

Email: "My parents won’t let me. They say my school grades aren’t good enough and I have to stay at home and study."
qs.exp: Roditelji joj ne daju izaći (won’t let me) → because of her parents. Loše ocjene su razlog roditelja, ali odluka je roditeljska.

qs.q:
When must Sienna and Alice give in their project work?

Email: "I must have it on Wednesday so I can produce a finished product on Thursday. We have to hand it in on Friday so Mr Davies can look at it during the weekend."
qs.exp: Projekt predaju četvrtkom? Ne — predaju ga u petak (hand it in on Friday). Srijeda je rok za Sienna’s dio, ali predaja je u petak.

qs.q:
What is Nathan Hunt’s occupation?

"There was a big demand for people to teach English and I got a job as a teacher in Gap."
qs.exp: Nathan radi kao učitelj engleskog (English teacher) u Gapu. Slikanje je za vikende.

qs.q:
What did Nathan Hunt study at university?

"But studying architecture gave me discipline. It brought structure to my painting."
qs.exp: Nathan je studirao arhitekturu (architecture) — kaže da mu je dalo disciplinu.

qs.q:
Where is Nathan Hunt from?

"People often say ‘Why do you, a Londoner, want to live here?’"
qs.exp: Nathan je Lonđanin (“a Londoner”) — rodni grad je London.

qs.q:
What is Nathan Hunt’s favourite painting?

"But this painting, ‘Shepherdess’, is not for sale. I will always have it with me in my studio."
qs.exp: ‘Shepherdess’ nije na prodaju i uvijek je želi imati u ateljeju → omiljena slika.

qs.q:
What is Nathan Hunt’s most famous painting?

"If you travel on the London Underground, you have probably seen a poster of ‘Moonlight’, the painting, which has brought the artist, Nathan Hunt, to the international scene."
qs.exp: ‘Moonlight’ je slika koja ga je proslavila i onu na plakatima londonskog metroa.

qs.q:
Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F). One letter is not needed.

16. Mr Cullen worked as a sales manager. He wanted to make changes, but the owners ignored him ___.
17. It had 6,000 square feet ___.
18. It had a very successful slogan, ___.
19. Since it had a parking lot, ___.
20. After Mr Cullen’s death, his wife ran the business ___.
rights: A — and later his children took over.
B — so he decided to open his own shop.
C — so they closed the shop.
D — it attracted customers from far away.
E — and was situated next to a very busy shopping district.
F — which meant the place was full of goods at low prices.

pairs.r: B — so he decided to open his own shop.
E — and was situated next to a very busy shopping district.
F — which meant the place was full of goods at low prices.
D — it attracted customers from far away.
A — and later his children took over.

qs.exp: 16=B, 17=E, 18=F, 19=D, 20=A prema ključu. C je suvišno.

qs.q: I need a ___ over the summer holidays.
qs.exp: ‘A job’ = posao (uzčlančeni). ‘Work’ je nebroj, ‘money’ ne odgovara kontekstu prijave za au pair.

qs.q: Let me tell you something about myself ___ a person.
qs.exp: ‘As a person’ = kao osoba. ‘As’ u ulozi/svojstvu. ‘Like’ bi značilo sličnost, ne identifikaciju.

qs.q: I love ___ jokes and singing.
qs.exp: ‘Tell jokes’ = pričati šale. Fiksna kolokacija — ne ‘speak/say jokes’.

qs.q: I’m great ___ acting, too.
qs.exp: ‘Be great at something’ = biti dobar u nečemu. Fiksna prepozicija: ‘at’.

qs.q: I’ve got ___ experience with kids.
qs.exp: ‘Some experience’ = neko iskustvo (nebroj. imenica). ‘Lot’ zahtijeva ‘a lot of’, ‘an’ ne ide uz nebroj. imenice.

qs.q: Millions of kids skateboard but only a ___ find a sponsor.
qs.exp: ‘Only a few’ = samo nekolicina. ‘Few’ s brojevima/množinom — suprotno od ‘many’.

qs.q: Is your skating good ___ to get you free gear?
qs.exp: ‘Good enough’ = dovoljno dobro. ‘Enough’ dolazi iza pridjeva.

qs.q: Make a video of your best skating ___ companies can see you in action.
qs.exp: ‘So (that)’ = kako bi, da. Izražava svrhu: ‘make a video so companies can see you’.

qs.q: Pick a company and find out ___ you need to talk to.
qs.exp: ‘Find out who’ = saznaj tko. Indirektno pitanje s ‘who’ kao subjektom.

qs.q: Companies look ___ skaters with a great personality.
qs.exp: ‘Look for’ = tražiti. Phrasal verb: companies look for (skaters) = traže skejtaše.

qs.q:
Write a reply to Thea’s message. Answer ALL her questions. Write 40–60 words.

Thea’s message:
“I’ve been accepted into an exchange programme. Your school looks cool but I’d like to hear it from you. How much homework do you have? What do I have to know about tests? What is your favourite subject and why?”

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor — treba odgovoriti na 3 pitanja: (1) koliko domaćih zadaća, (2) što treba znati o testovima, (3) omiljeni predmet i zašto. Primjer: “Hi Thea! We usually have 1-2 hours of homework a day. Tests happen every few weeks — you need to study regularly. My favourite subject is English because I love learning about different cultures. Can’t wait to meet you!”

qs.q:
You hear 5 phone messages. What is the main message of each speaker?
Match each message with one of the statements (A–F). One letter is not needed.
items: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
Message 5
rights: B — You don’t have to come.

pairs.l: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
pairs.r: B — You don’t have to come.

pairs.l: Message 4
Message 5

qs.exp: 1=E (you’ll enjoy it = you should come), 2=C (parents out, come over = you can come), 3=B (it’s up to you = you don’t have to), 4=D (girls only, sorry = you cannot come), 5=A (everyone must be there = you have to come). F je suvišno.

qs.q: A man is talking on the phone to a restaurant receptionist. What’s the man’s name?
qs.exp: Iz transkripta: “Wex. That’s W-E-X.” → Mr. Wex.

qs.q: Two people are talking in a travel agency. How much will their accommodation cost them per day?
qs.exp: Hotel = €25 po osobi = €50 za dvoje. Apartman = €40 za dvoje, ali ne uključuje hranu. Odlučili za hotel → €50 dnevno.

qs.q: Two friends are talking in a shop. Where are they?
qs.exp: Iz transkripta: kupuju knjigu (“It won the Booker Prize for fiction”, “I’ll just pay for it”) → knjižara (bookshop).

qs.q: Katie is talking to a friend before school. Why hasn’t Katie got her homework?
opts: She didn’t know how to do it.
qs.exp: Iz transkripta: Katie je zaboravila staviti domaću zadaću u torbu (“I forgot to put it in my bag”) → she left it at home.

qs.q: Two friends are talking about their plans for a party. What will they buy for the party?
qs.exp: Pića već imaju, CD-ove donosi jedan od njih. Trebaju kupiti kikiriki (peanuts) — “We have to get peanuts.”

qs.q: Chuck has a BRIT award for…
qs.exp: Chuck: “I’m glad it was for the album because it shows more of your work than a single.” → Best Album.

qs.q: Chuck’s songs are about…
qs.exp: Chuck: “Why are people violent? It’s because they’re frustrated. This is the real issue.” → frustration.

qs.q: Chuck started playing the guitar when he was…
qs.exp: Chuck: “He taught me my first chords when I was 4.” (s 2 godine se igrao gitarom, ali svirati počeo s 4).

qs.q: Chuck’s first professional performance was at a…
qs.exp: Chuck: “It’s where we first played for money” → klub. Prva nastupa (besplatno) bila je na školskim plesnjacima, ali prva profesionalna (za novac) bila je u klubovima.

qs.q: Next, Chuck will…
qs.exp: Chuck: “We plan to tour round the country... and we need some more songs for that.” → First writes songs, then tours. Iduće: pisanje pjesama.

qs.q: What is the number of the road from Whitstable to Crawford?
qs.exp: Transkript: “Whitstable via the A202.”

qs.q: Until what time can you enter the Gym on Tuesdays?
qs.exp: Gym radi pon-sri do 20h, zadnji ulaz 1 sat prije zatvaranja → zadnji ulaz u utorak je u 19h (7 pm).

qs.q: Before your first visit to the Gym, you need to…
qs.exp: Transkript: “guests are not allowed to use the gym before they see a qualified instructor.” Termin je preporučen, ali obveza je vidjeti instruktora.

qs.q: The Personal Programme…
qs.exp: Transkript: “There is a fee for this, but there is no extra charge for members.” → za članove je uključeno u članstvo (in the membership price).

qs.q: The Centre is looking for…
qs.exp: Transkript: “There is also a volunteer programme... If you are interested in helping out, please contact us.” → traže volontere.

qs.q:
Match the messages (1–5) and statements (A–F).
There is one letter you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. Why don't we spend a quiet evening at home tonight? We can watch a movie or make some tea and relax.
2. I've bought a new desk. Can you come over and help me carry it up the stairs to my room?
3. Steve's offered us to stay in his flat until we find a suitable place to live. He of all people! I can't believe it!
4. The car looks amazing in the photo. But it's a second-hand car, so be careful if you plan to buy it.
5. You didn't hand in the report on time and yesterday you left the office early. Can you give me an explanation?
items: 1 — Why don't we spend a quiet evening at home? Watch a movie or relax.
2 — I've bought a new desk. Can you come over and help me carry it up the stairs?
3 — Steve's offered us to stay in his flat! He of all people! I can't believe it!
4 — It's a second-hand car, so be careful if you plan to buy it.
5 — You didn't hand in the report on time. Can you give me an explanation?

pairs.l: 1 — Why don't we spend a quiet evening at home? Watch a movie or relax.
2 — I've bought a new desk. Can you come over and help me carry it up the stairs?
3 — Steve's offered us to stay in his flat! He of all people! I can't believe it!
4 — It's a second-hand car, so be careful if you plan to buy it.
5 — You didn't hand in the report on time. Can you give me an explanation?

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (tiha večer kod kuće, film ili čaj) = D (Let's stay in). Poruka 2 (treba pomoć s nošenjem pisaćeg stola) = E (Give me a hand). Poruka 3 (nevjerojatno da je Steve ponudio stan) = A (I'm amazed). Poruka 4 (rabljeni auto — pazi) = F (Watch out). Poruka 5 (zašto kasniš s izvještajem?) = B (Tell me why).

qs.q:
Why isn't Gail having a birthday party?

"I'm cancelling my birthday party. I went to a lot of trouble to organise everything and, particularly, to send my parents away for the day. Then I got this coupon for a free weekend in London for two, which I couldn't ignore. So my friend Sarah is coming with me."

A Because of her parents.
B Because of a trip.
C Because of a friend.
qs.exp: 'I got a coupon for a FREE WEEKEND IN LONDON for two, which I couldn't ignore' → putovanje = B (Because of a trip).

qs.q:
When do Boyd and Luke have their exam?

"Come over to my place on Wednesday. I know you didn't want to study the day before the exam, but I think revising will make us less anxious. Don't forget the deadline for handing in the assignments is the Tuesday before the exam. They'll correct and mark them by Thursday."

A On Tuesday.
B On Wednesday.
C On Thursday.
qs.exp: Deadline je utorak, Luke poziva u srijedu ('day before the exam'), ispiti se označavaju do četvrtka → ispit je u ČETVRTAK = C.

qs.q:
How often does Nina walk her dog?

"My mom takes Mickey out every morning and I take him out for long walks in the evenings. For several weeks during the exams, though, I was able to walk him only at weekends."

A Every day.
B Several times a week.
C At weekends.
qs.exp: Mama svako jutro + Nina svake večeri = SVAKI DAN (A). Vikendi su samo za ispitno razdoblje, ne normalno.

qs.q:
What does Harry say about his job?

"It's strange to sit in an office all day but it feels good when you complete a report that makes your client happy. And a bit of fun at the pub after work helps too."

A It's exhausting.
B It's rewarding.
C It's fun.
qs.exp: 'It feels good when you complete a report that MAKES YOUR CLIENT HAPPY' = zadovoljstvo/nagrada = B (rewarding).

qs.q:
What does Sarah want Claire to bring to the meeting?

"I think you can bring the report up-to-date fairly quickly. Let's meet at school tomorrow. You have to come over with the latest data. I'll bring along the notes from our last meeting."

A The report.
B The data.
C Her notes.
qs.exp: 'You have to come over with the LATEST DATA' → Sarah traži od Claire najnovije podatke = B (The data).

qs.q:
A Clown to Remember

"Eugene Skelton, or Quacky, as his audiences will remember him."

Stage name: ___
qs.exp: 'or QUACKY, as his audiences will remember him' → scensko ime je Quacky.

A Clown to Remember

"Before becoming a professional clown, he worked as a clerk for five years because he had to provide for his family."

First job: ___
qs.exp: 'Worked as a CLERK for five years' → prvi posao je bio clerk (činovnik).

qs.q:
A Clown to Remember

"His first contact with Hollywood came in the form of a failed screen test for Clown Family. In 1964 he made his film debut in Wonderful Time and became famous."

First film: ___
qs.exp: 'Made his film DEBUT in WONDERFUL TIME' → prvi film je Wonderful Time.

qs.q:
A Clown to Remember

"Eugene's acts took the family across the country and into America for festivals during the summer. In the winter, with the family at home in Canada, he travelled solo."

Country of residence: ___
qs.exp: 'With the family at home in CANADA' → zemlja stanovanja je Kanada.

qs.q:
A Clown to Remember

"His son, who is a comedian... says: 'My sister and I often had to help dad blow the balloons.'"

Number of children: ___
qs.exp: 'My SISTER AND I' → sin i kćer = dvoje djece.
