qs.q:
Eilean Donan

"The castle is located on (21) ___ own little island and surrounded by the forested mountains."

A his
B it's
C its
qs.exp: 'Located on ITS own little island' — posvojni 'its' (bez apostrofa) za neživo. 'It's' = it is (pogrešno), 'his' = muško.

qs.q:
Eilean Donan

"The castle that visitors enjoy today (22) ___ reconstructed as a family home between 1912 and 1932."

A was
B is
C has been
qs.exp: 'Between 1912 and 1932' = specifičan period u prošlosti → past simple passive: WAS reconstructed.

qs.q:
Eilean Donan

"There are numerous reasons (23) ___ it enjoys such romantic and iconic status."

A how
B why
C when
qs.exp: 'Reasons WHY it enjoys such status' — 'why' uvodi zavisnu surečenicu razloga uz 'reasons'.

qs.q:
Eilean Donan

"To truly understand the appeal of this castle you (24) ___ to go and discover it for yourself."

A have
B should
C must
qs.exp: 'You HAVE to go and discover it' — 'have to' = moraš (nužnost). Kontekst sugerira da trebaš osobno posjetiti.

qs.q:
Eilean Donan

"There is an audio guide tour. It is available (25) ___ eight languages."

A by
B on
C in
qs.exp: 'Available IN eight languages' — prijedlog 'in' uz jezike: available in English/French/etc.

qs.q:
Alphabet

"We are so used (26) ___ the idea of an alphabet nowadays that it's difficult to imagine a time without it."

(Upiši jednu riječ)
qs.exp: 'Used TO the idea' — fiksna kolokacija: be used to something = naviknuti na nešto.

qs.q:
Alphabet

"It's difficult to imagine a time (27) ___ it was not a routine part of everyday life."

(Upiši jednu riječ)
qs.exp: 'A time WHEN it was not routine' — relativna zamjenica 'when' za vremenski antecedent (time).

qs.q:
Alphabet

"Once we (28) ___ learned to read, we don't think twice about putting things into alphabetical order."

(Upiši jednu riječ)
qs.exp: 'Once we HAVE learned to read' — present perfect u vremenskoj surečenici s 'once' (čim smo naučili).

qs.q:
Alphabet

"We also expect words to be in alphabetical order when we look them (29) ___ in a dictionary."

(Upiši jednu riječ)
qs.exp: 'Look them UP in a dictionary' — frazalni glagol: look up = potražiti (u rječniku).

qs.q:
Alphabet

"He felt it was (30) ___ a new idea that he had to explain how his 'Table Alphabeticall' should be used."

(Upiši jednu riječ)
qs.exp: 'It was SUCH a new idea that...' — 'such' uz imeničku skupinu za naglašavanje (such a/an + adj + noun + that).

qs.q:
Read this message from Kerry:

"Hi
I'm thinking about changing school because I'm not happy here. Are you happy with your school and why? What are your classmates and teachers like? What would you like to change in your school?
Kerry"

Write Kerry a reply. Answer ALL her questions. Write 50–70 words.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) jesi li zadovoljan/na školom i zašto, (2) kakvi su ti razredni kolege i nastavnici, (3) što bi promijenio/la u školi. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi). Stariji format — kraća dužina.

qs.q:
You will hear 5 phone messages.
Match the messages (1–5) and the statements (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

A — I'm busy.
B — I heard it from you.
C — I'd like to visit you.
D — Thank you.
E — It's all right.
F — I agree with you.
rights: B — I heard it from you.
C — I'd like to visit you.

pairs.r: C — I'd like to visit you.

qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q7 = B (Mr Payne).

qs.q:
You hear a radio interview with Sunita Hire, a NASA astronaut.

Sunita thinks that being an astronaut is…

as difficult for a woman as for a man.
less difficult for a woman than for a man.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q11 = A (more difficult for a woman).

qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q12 = C (a vet / veterinarka).

qs.q: At the beginning of her professional career, Sunita was…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q13 = C (a helicopter pilot).

qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q14 = A (195 days).

qs.q: For Sunita, the hardest part of going to space is…

qs.q:
You hear an animator talking to a group visiting a wellness centre.

The price of the group's wellness programme includes…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q16 = B (a Swedish massage).

qs.q: The group can use the swimming pool…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q17 = B (from 15:00 to 16:00 only).

qs.q: The people in the group should…
opts: hire bathrobes and towels at the spa.
buy bathrobes and towels at the spa.
use their own bathrobes and towels.
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q18 = C (use their own bathrobes and towels).

qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q19 = A (a vegetarian dish).

qs.q: The group should be at the bus for the spa at…
qs.exp: Prema ključu: Q20 = A (12:45).

qs.q: Match the messages (1–5) and statements (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.
items: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
Message 5

pairs.l: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
Message 5

qs.exp: 1=C (I feel awful = I’m sorry), 2=E (stop lying = tell the truth), 3=F (don’t mess it up = keep it clean), 4=A (I need you for arranging = give me a hand), 5=B (you make the meal = I won’t do it). D je suvišno.

qs.q: Why didn’t Rob go to Hannah’s party last night?
qs.exp: Rob je radio noćnu smjenu umjesto Tije — bio je zauzet (busy). Nije zaboravio; bio je iscrpljen tek jutro nakon.

qs.q: Who has Betty bought the dress for?
qs.exp: Betty kaže: “When I saw it on you I knew it was perfect.” — kupila je haljinu za Kyru. Ako Kyri ne odgovara, zadržat će je sama ili dati Sandri.

20. It wasn’t there ___.
rights: A — where I had put it
B — to go out with my mates in her clothes
C — because my sister had taken it
F — where it would be safe

pairs.r: B — to go out with my mates in her clothes
F — where it would be safe
A — where I had put it

qs.q: The two main resources ___ they need to find are food and nesting locations.
qs.exp: ‘Resources which they need’ — odnosna zamjenica za stvari (ne osobe) = which.

qs.q: Birds migrate to the north in the spring to ___ advantage of insects and plants.
qs.exp: ‘Take advantage of’ = iskoristiti. Fiksna fraza u engleskom.

qs.q: Many species ___ survive freezing temperatures if they can find enough food.
qs.exp: ‘Can survive’ = mogu preživjeti (mogućnost). Kontekst: “escaping the cold is motivating BUT many species can survive” — naglasak na sposobnosti.

qs.q: Birds return in spring to the area in which they ___ born.
qs.exp: Past simple passive: ‘were born’ = rođeni su. Kontekst u prošlom vremenu, bez potrebe za perfect.

qs.q: They find their way using navigation ___ the stars.
qs.exp: ‘By the stars’ = pomoću zvijezda (instrument/sredstvo). ‘Navigation by the stars’ = zvjezdana navigacija.

qs.q: It originates from the battle tactics used ___ the great Indian generals.
qs.exp: Pasivna konstrukcija: ‘used by’ = koriste od strane. Agentna prepozicija u pasivu.

qs.q: Kabaddi is played on a pitch which is similar ___ a tennis court.
qs.exp: ‘Similar to’ = sličan nečemu. Fiksna prepozicija.

qs.q: Seven players make up each team and they can ___ attack or defend.
qs.exp: ‘Either ... or’ = ili ... ili. ‘Either attack or defend’.

qs.q: When this happens, points ___ scored and the tagged players have to leave the game.
qs.exp: Pasiv prezenta: ‘points are scored’ = bodovi se osvajaju.

qs.q: The raider ___ to keep chanting ‘kabaddi, kabaddi’ while he is in the opposition half.
qs.exp: ‘Has to’ = mora (obveza). Ključ prihvaća i ‘ought’ (ought to = trebao bi).

qs.q:
Write a reply to Melissa’s message. Answer ALL her questions. Write 50–70 words.

Melissa’s message:
“I’ve moved to another part of town and I’m disappointed with the change. What’s your neighbourhood like? What about your neighbours? Would you like to stay there in the future and why?”

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor — treba odgovoriti na 3 pitanja: (1) kakav je kvart, (2) kakvi su susjedi, (3) želiš li ostati i zašto. Primjer: “Hi Melissa! My neighbourhood is quiet and green, with a park nearby. My neighbours are friendly — we always say hello. I’d like to stay here in the future because it’s safe and close to the city centre. I hope you’ll feel better about your new area soon!”

items: 1 — I know I promised to join you at the party, but I won't be able to make it.
2 — I don't want you to carry the furniture alone. I'll be back by 5.
3 — She must be out of reach, but I'm sure she'll call soon.
4 — I may sound strict, but you're staying in and that's final.
5 — It would be stupid to give up the project now that you're almost done.

pairs.l: 1 — I know I promised to join you at the party, but I won't be able to make it.
2 — I don't want you to carry the furniture alone. I'll be back by 5.
3 — She must be out of reach, but I'm sure she'll call soon.
4 — I may sound strict, but you're staying in and that's final.
5 — It would be stupid to give up the project now that you're almost done.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (ne mogu doći na zabavu) = C (Sorry I can't go). Poruka 2 (ne nosite namještaj sami, čekajte me) = E (Wait for me). Poruka 3 (ne brini, sigurno će nazvati) = D (Don't worry). Poruka 4 (ostaješ kod kuće, konačno) = F (You can't go). Poruka 5 (glupo bi bilo odustati sad kad si gotovo završio) = B (Carry on).

B At the cinema.
C At a friend's house.

qs.q:
Why is Paul taking the job?

"It would be okay if it helped me become a better lawyer, or if I needed to help my folks pay the bills. But my parents keep on telling me to get out of the house and get a job, and I've had enough of that."

A To get some experience.
B Because of his parents.
C To earn some money.
qs.exp: 'My parents KEEP ON TELLING me to get out of the house and get a job, and I've had ENOUGH OF THAT' → uzima posao zbog roditelja = B.

qs.q:
What is Emily going to study in London?

"We'll spend the first month sketching in museums and galleries to learn about the different historical periods and styles. I'll have to take photos for documentation."

A Art.
B History.
C Photography.
qs.exp: 'SKETCHING in museums and galleries to learn about historical periods and STYLES' = studij likovne umjetnosti = A (Art).

qs.q:
How much did Connor spend at the music shop?

"I got a £25 gift voucher for the music shop for my birthday, and I went to get Deadly Tulips' new CD for £12. But it's not out yet, so I got an old one for £8. I'll get the new one next week and still have £5 to spend."

A £8.
B £12.
C £20.
qs.exp: 'Got an old one FOR £8' → potrošio je £8 ovog posjeta = A. Novi CD (£12) će kupiti sljedeći tjedan.

qs.q:
Why is Charlie going to Paris?

"My father is going on business and he's taking me with him to study French while we're there. I promised myself I'd do something useful this summer."

A On business.
B On holiday.
C On a course.

Read this message from Jayden:

"Hi
School's almost over. Where will you go this summer? How long will you stay there? What will you do?
Jayden"

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kamo ćeš ići ovog ljeta, (2) koliko dugo ćeš ostati, (3) što ćeš raditi. Dužina 40–60 riječi (kratki format — 2012. ispit). Neformalan registar, budućno vrijeme (will/going to).

qs.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (40–60 riječi). Isti kratki format kao 2013. ispit.

qs.q:
Match the messages (1–5) and suggestions (A–F).
There is one letter you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [g = Stay with me.]
1. I know Peter is the youngest in the family, but it's only a two-day school trip. I'm sure he'll be fine.
2. Develop some effective strategies and stop improvising. Your friends can't give you a hand all the time.
3. It's an open-air concert and the weather forecast is not promising. You don't want to get wet.
4. Enjoy your time at the beach. Even if it rains a bit on Saturday, it will be fun.
5. Some friends are coming over. Please greet them with a smile. I want them to like you.
items: 1 — It's only a two-day school trip. I'm sure he'll be fine.
2 — Develop effective strategies and stop improvising.
3 — Open-air concert, not promising weather. You don't want to get wet.
4 — Enjoy your time at the beach. Even if it rains a bit.
5 — Some friends are coming over. Greet them with a smile.

pairs.l: 1 — It's only a two-day school trip. I'm sure he'll be fine.
2 — Develop effective strategies and stop improvising.
3 — Open-air concert, not promising weather. You don't want to get wet.
4 — Enjoy your time at the beach. Even if it rains a bit.
5 — Some friends are coming over. Greet them with a smile.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (ne brini za Petra, školski izlet) = C (Stop worrying). Poruka 2 (razvij strategije, ne improviziraj) = A (Plan your actions). Poruka 3 (otvoreni koncert, kiša moguća) = D (Take a raincoat). Poruka 4 (užij na plaži, nema veze ako malo kiši) = E (Have a nice weekend). Poruka 5 (dočekaj prijatelje s osmijehom) = B (Be friendly).

qs.q:
What should Jamie take to the party?

"You're welcome to bring something to eat, though I'll prepare something. My brother and his mates will take care of drinks, but you can bring your own. We're counting on you for some good music, though."

A Music.
B Food.
C Drinks.
qs.exp: 'We're COUNTING ON YOU for some GOOD MUSIC' → Jamie treba donijeti glazbu = A.

qs.q:
What does Ella say Will is like?

"What do you think of Will, the new boy in the class? He often looks bored in class. Perhaps it's nothing new for him. It's difficult to decide about him because he doesn't say much. But I'm sure he'll fit in with time."

A Boring.
B Quiet.
C Fit.
qs.exp: 'He DOESN'T SAY MUCH' = šutljiv = B (Quiet). 'Looks bored' opisuje izgled, ne osobnost.

qs.q:
Why won't Josh go to George's party?

"I can't stand the guy. You'll have to make an excuse for me. Don't tell him I can't come because I've got homework to do. I don't want to sound like a nerd. Tell him I'm sick. It's the flu!"

A He is ill.
B He is busy.
C He doesn't want to.
qs.exp: 'I CAN'T STAND the guy' = ne podnosi Georgea → ne želi ići = C. Bolest je izmišljeni izgovor.

qs.q:
What does Chloe have to do?

"Aunt Rose is coming to visit us tomorrow afternoon. You mustn't leave the flat so there's someone to welcome her. Why don't you finish your homework while you're waiting? And you could clean up your room – it's a mess!"

A Stay at home.
B Finish her homework.
C Clean her room.
qs.exp: 'You MUSTN'T LEAVE THE FLAT' = mora ostati doma = A (Stay at home). Domaća zadaća i soba su sugestije, ne obveze.

qs.q:
What does Matilda say about her presentation?

"At least I didn't bore my classmates and my teacher to death. In fact, I got lots of questions. But it took me a long time to prepare it, and I was disappointed with the mark I got."

A It was interesting.
B It was disappointing.
C It was long.
qs.exp: 'Didn't bore classmates' + 'got lots of questions' = prezentacija je bila ZANIMLJIVA = A (interesting). Matilda je RAZOČARANA ocjenom, ne prezentacijom.

qs.q:
Travels in Asia — Don Carn

1. I know it's a tough choice, but I can't wait any longer for your decision.

items: 1 — I know it's a tough choice, but I can't wait any longer for your decision.
2 — You must think about the consequences. If you don't, you might hurt someone.

4 — Think twice before you resign; you might feel different in the morning.

pairs.l: 1 — I know it's a tough choice, but I can't wait any longer for your decision.
2 — You must think about the consequences. If you don't, you might hurt someone.
3 — Keep it to yourself. Nobody needs to know about it.
4 — Think twice before you resign; you might feel different in the morning.
5 — I'm really sorry, but this meeting is a must. No excuses this time.

qs.exp: Poruka 1 (teška odluka, ne mogu više čekati) = D (Make up your mind). Poruka 2 (misli na posljedice, možeš nekome nauditi) = A (Be responsible). Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F). One letter is not needed.

16. When arriving at hotels, ___.
17. It is wise ___, which hotel staff will gladly do.
18. In many cities, various models are available but ___.
19. Motorcycle taxis are practical only ___.
20. In major cities, bicycle rickshaws ___.
rights: A — if you are staying at a hotel
B — they cost about the same as a taxi
C — to bring along a Chinese dictionary
D — if you are travelling alone
E — they usually have different rates
F — to have your destination written down in Chinese

pairs.r: A — if you are staying at a hotel
F — to have your destination written down in Chinese
E — they usually have different rates
D — if you are travelling alone
B — they cost about the same as a taxi

qs.exp: 16=A, 17=F, 18=E, 19=D, 20=B prema ključu. C je suvišno.

qs.q: It’s a great help having a friend ___ going through the same things as me.
qs.exp: ‘Who’s’ = who is (skraćeno). ‘A friend who is going through the same things’ — odnosna zamjenica za osobu + glagol to be.

qs.q: ...boys who ___ fun of me.
qs.exp: ‘Make fun of someone’ = ismijavati nekoga. Fiksna kolokacija.

qs.q: Someone who’ll help me with my homework if ___ need it.
qs.exp: U uvjetnoj rečenici s ‘if’ (zero/first conditional) → present simple: ‘if I need it’.

qs.q: Someone who I can talk to about the big decisions, like what to study or which party ___ go to.
qs.exp: ‘Which party I should go to’ — indirektno pitanje → uobičajen red riječi (subjekt + glagol).

qs.q: What I can’t stand, ___, is someone who wants to live my life for me.
qs.exp: ‘However’ = međutim (prilog za suprotnost). ‘Even though’ i ‘although’ su veznici koji zahtijevaju rečenicu.

qs.q: She travelled a lot in the Far East at a time ___ very few Europeans did.
qs.exp: ‘At a time when’ = u vrijeme kad. Relativna zamjenica za vremenski antecedent.

qs.q: When she looked ___ my sisters and me, when we were very small...
qs.exp: ‘Look after’ = čuvati, brinuti se. Phrasal verb.

qs.q: ...she always let us do exciting things, but she also made sure we did not hurt ___.
qs.exp: ‘Hurt ourselves’ = povrijediti se (povratna zamjenica za 1. lice množine).

qs.q: She’s visiting us ___ a few days and she’ll stay for the summer.
qs.exp: ‘In a few days’ = za nekoliko dana (prepozicija za budućnost).

qs.q: ___ will be great to see her again.
qs.exp: ‘It will be great’ — bezlična zamjenica ‘it’ za opće tvrdnje.

qs.q:
Write a reply to Esme’s message. Answer ALL her questions. Write 40–60 words.

Esme’s message:
“I’m coming to visit your town next Saturday. What should I visit and why? Can you tell me where we can meet and how to get there? Is there anything you’d like me to bring you or your family?”

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor — treba odgovoriti na 3 pitanja: (1) što posjetiti i zašto, (2) gdje se naići i kako doći, (3) želiš li nešto da donese. Primjer: “Hi Esme! You should visit the old town centre — it’s beautiful. Let’s meet in front of the cathedral at 10am — take tram 2. Could you bring some chocolate? My family loves it!”

pairs.r: F — I’ll give you a ride.

pairs.l: Message 2
Message 3

Message 5

qs.exp: Prema listu za odgovore: 1=F, 2=D, 3=E, 4=A, 5=C. B je suvišno.

qs.q: A man is talking to a receptionist in a doctor’s surgery. What’s his surname?
qs.exp: Prezime se izgovara kao Rider — ne Raider ni Ryder. Receptionist potvrđuje u ordinaciji.

qs.q: Helen and Kate are talking about a dancing course Helen took. How much did the course cost Helen?
qs.exp: Tečaj plesa koštao je Helen £150 (B). Nije £120 ni £170 — Helen i Kate razgovaraju o cijeni tečaja.

qs.q: Two friends are talking. Where are they going next?
qs.exp: Prijatelji idu u knjižaru (bookshop) — ne u kafić ni restoran.

qs.q: Two students are talking about the new maths teacher. What’s he like?
qs.exp: Novi profesor matematike je pravičean (fair). Nije strog ni smiješan prema razgovoru dvoje učenika.

qs.q: Matt is talking about his school. Why did he decide to move to another school?
opts: To have more time for sports.
To get away from his classmates.
Because it’s closer to his home.
qs.exp: Matt se prebacio u drugu školu kako bi imao više vremena za sport (A). Nije zbog razrednih kolega ni udaljenosti od kuće.

qs.q: What did cooking mean to Kate before MasterChef?
opts: It was a way to relax.
It was a way of expressing her creativity.
qs.exp: Prije MasterChefa kuhanje je Kate služilo za opuštanje (way to relax). Nije bila obaveza ni kreativni izričaj.

qs.q: What was Kate’s motive for taking part in the show?
opts: To prove she is the best.
qs.exp: Kate se prijavila da postane bolji kuhar (better cook). Nije išla dokazivati se ni pobijediti na nagradi.

qs.q: How did Kate feel during MasterChef?
qs.exp: Kate se osjećala mirno (calm) za vrijeme MasterChefa. Nije bila razoarena ni pod stresom.

qs.q: How many children has Kate got?
qs.exp: Kate ima troje djece (three). Nije dvoje ni četvoro.

qs.q: What is Kate’s favourite dessert?
qs.exp: Kate’s omiljeni desert je lemon tart (C). Nije crème brûlée ni chocolate pudding.

qs.q: The students have to be at the museum at:
qs.exp: Učenici moraju biti u muzeju u 10.50 (B). Nije 10:30 ni 11:15.

qs.q: To enter the exhibition, the students will have to pay:
qs.exp: Ulaz na izložbu košta £6 (A). Nije £7 ni besplatan.

qs.q: Their guided tour will start:
qs.exp: Vođena tura počinje u Crvenoj zoni (Red Zone). Nije u Plavoj ni Zelenoj.

qs.q: The teacher recommends that they see:
qs.exp: Nastavnik preporučuje odjel mineralogije (Minerals Section). Nije Earth Lab ni Human Biology.

qs.q: The last place the students will visit in the museum is:
qs.exp: Zadnje mjesto je Darwin Centre (B). Nije muzejski restoran ni prodavaonica suvenira.

qs.q: Match the messages (1–5) and questions/statements (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.
items: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
Message 5
rights: B — Have you got the time?

pairs.l: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
pairs.r: B — Have you got the time?

pairs.l: Message 5

qs.exp: 1=F (I’ve got lots of things to do = I’m busy), 2=E (come round to my place = visit me), 3=A (I’d love to hear about it = how was your holiday?), 4=B (are you sure you can go tonight? = have you got the time?), 5=D (I’m getting better = I’m doing fine). C je suvišno.

qs.q: What was Jimmy’s flight like?
qs.exp: Jimmy se bojao ali ga je susjed zabavljao pričama → let je bio zanimljiv (interesting). Razočaranje je bilo što ga nitko nije dočekao, ali pitanje se tiče leta.

qs.q: How much did Brendan pay for his new CD?
qs.exp: Ukupno £35. Koncert je više od dvostruke cijene CD-a, a za £10 možeš slušati stotine puta → CD = £10, koncert = £25.

qs.q: What did Myra give Sally for her birthday?
qs.exp: Myra je dala Da Vinci Code (knjiga) umjesto uobičajenog ruža ili likeća.

qs.q: Why did Muriel miss her meeting with Freda yesterday?
qs.exp: Muriel je pomogla prijateljici tražiti haljinu → helped a friend. Kupnja kartice bila je prvotni razlog izlaska, ali zašto je zakasnila je pomoć prijatelju.

qs.q: How does Daniel feel about the trip?
opts: He is looking forward to it.
qs.exp: “Can’t wait!” = jedva čeka → looking forward to it. Neće penjati do vrha ali ide na put.

qs.q: What is Clara Jacobs’ country of birth?
qs.exp: Clara je otišla iz Belgije u Ameriku sa 12 godina (“left Belgium for America at the age of twelve”).

qs.q: How old is Clara Jacobs?
qs.exp: Clara kaže: “my life is very different from that of an average twenty-two year old” → ima 22 godine.

qs.q: What is Clara’s father’s job?
qs.exp: Otac je počeo kao novinar (journalist) ali je postao Clarin trener (coach) full time.

qs.q: What is Clara’s hobby?
qs.exp: Clara: “I like to write in my free time”. Ostali interesi (art, music) su budući planovi.

qs.q: What is Clara’s current tennis ranking?
qs.exp: Clara je pala iz top 50 ali se vraća — “reached number twenty-eight”.

qs.q:
Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F). One letter is not needed.

16. Praise and reward your dog ___.
17. Correct your dog ___.
18. Believe in ___.
19. Help your dog by giving him a simple decision, then make it clear to him ___.
20. Your dog has to live with you, you are the leader of his pack ___.
rights: A — what you are doing and stick to it
B — and you must be the person he respects
C — which choice is acceptable and which isn’t
D — when he does what you ask him to
E — which can help him learn
F — if you catch him in the act of doing wrong

pairs.r: D — when he does what you ask him to
F — if you catch him in the act of doing wrong
A — what you are doing and stick to it
C — which choice is acceptable and which isn’t
B — and you must be the person he respects

qs.exp: 16=D, 17=F, 18=A, 19=C, 20=B prema ključu. E je suvišno.

qs.q: Today, it is a desirable thing that gives young people the ___ for personal growth.
qs.exp: ‘Opportunity for personal growth’ = prilika za osobni razvoj. Fiksna kolokacija.

qs.q: Taking a gap year is a long-accepted tradition in many European countries and ___ more and more popular around the world.
qs.exp: ‘Is becoming’ = postaje (present continuous za trend koji je u tijeku). ‘More and more popular’ indicira proces koji traje.

qs.q: You’d certainly grow in maturity if you ___ to Asia on your own.
qs.exp: Second conditional: ‘you’d grow... if you travelled’ — hipotetska situacija u prošlom vremenu.

qs.q: It’s a lifetime experience to volunteer in an African village and learn ___ their life and customs.
qs.exp: ‘Learn about’ = saznati o, naučiti o. Fiksna prepozicija uz learn u značenju saznati.

qs.q: ___ you make of your gap year is entirely up to you.
qs.exp: ‘What you make of’ = što načiniš od. ‘What’ uvodi imensku rečenicu u funkciji subjekta.

qs.q: Barbie... was the creation ___ Ruth Handler.
qs.exp: ‘Creation of’ = djelo/kreacija nečija. ‘The creation of Ruth Handler’.

qs.q: She made a doll ___ clothes could be changed.
qs.exp: ‘Whose’ = čije (odnosna zamjenica za posvojnost). ‘A doll whose clothes could be changed.’

qs.q: Today, there are Barbie collectors ready to pay as ___ as $25,000 for older versions.
qs.exp: ‘As much as’ = čak toliko. Struktura za isticanje iznosa/količine.

qs.q: In spite of Barbie’s success, ___ have been serious debates about her figure.
qs.exp: ‘There have been debates’ = bezlična egzistencijalna konstrukcija s ‘there’.

qs.q: So, in 1997 it ___ made wider, which promoted a more “real” model of the female body.
qs.exp: Pasiv prošlog vremena: ‘it was made wider’ = prošireno je.

qs.q:
Write a reply to Lexi’s message. Answer ALL her questions. Write 40–60 words.

Lexi’s message:
“I’ve lost my mobile phone and I feel lost without it. I use it all the time. When do you use your phone the most? Who do you usually phone and why? When do you switch it off?”

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor — treba odgovoriti na 3 pitanja: (1) kada najviše koristiš mobitel, (2) koga zoviš i zašto, (3) kada ga gašiš. Primjer: “Hi Lexi! I use my phone most in the evenings when I chat with friends. I usually call my mum to tell her when I’ll be home. I switch it off at night and during school so I can focus.”

qs.q: A man is talking to a receptionist in a hospital clinic. What’s the man’s surname?
qs.exp: Prezime se izgovara kao Gors. Nije Jors ni Joas — receptionist ponavlja za potvrdu u klinici.

qs.q: Two friends are talking about holiday accommodation. How much will it cost them?
qs.exp: Hotel = €200 po osobi (2 osobe = €400). Apartman je €800 za tjedan bez doručka. Odlučili za hotel.

qs.q: Two friends are talking in the street. Where will they go next?
qs.exp: Nakon razgovora prijatelji idu u galeriju (A). Sandwich bar i bankomat su bila razmatranja ali ne odlaze tamo.

qs.q: Jack is talking about Sue’s party on Saturday. Why won’t he go to the party?
qs.exp: Jack neće na zabavu jer mu Sue nije draga (doesn’t fancy her). Nema pozivnice, ali razlog je osobna nesympathija.

qs.q: Two friends are talking about joining a fitness class. What do they need for the class?
qs.exp: Za fitness sat potrebna je liječnička potvrda (medical certificate). Iskustvo nije uvjet, a tenisice će trebati ali nisu jedini uvjet.

qs.q: In the cinema, Toby…
qs.exp: Toby je u kinu pojeo grickalicu (ate a snack). Nije tamo gledao film ni susreo djevojču.

qs.q: When Toby saw his girlfriend, he felt…
qs.exp: Kad je ugledao djevojču, Toby se osjećao olakšano (relieved) — bio je zabrinut ranije ali je nestalo brige.

qs.q: His girlfriend was at the mall entrance because…
qs.exp: Djevojča je bila pri ulazu u shopping centar jer je došlo do nesporazuma o mjestu susreta (misunderstanding).

qs.q: Toby bought himself…
qs.exp: Toby je kupio nešto za jesti (item of food). Nije odjeću ni higijenske proizvode.

qs.q: In the end, Toby watched a film…
qs.exp: Na kraju Toby je gledao film kod kuće (at home). Nije ostao u kinu ni otiao kod djevojče.

qs.q: Chilton House is open on…
qs.exp: Chilton House je otvoren četvrtkom (Thursdays). Nije nedjeljom ni ponedjeljkom.

qs.q: Entry to the House…
qs.exp: Ulaz u Chilton House je besplatan (free). Nije £3 ni £5.

qs.q: For evening visits…
qs.exp: Za večernje posjete: ne možeš ući nakon 20h (8pm). Nije nužno rano rezervirati ni stići točno u 18h.

qs.q: In the House, you must not…
qs.exp: U kući nije dopušteno fotografirati (take photographs). Mobitel i torba nisu zabranjeni.

qs.q: Visitors can eat…
qs.exp: Posjetitelji mogu jesti u vrtu (in the garden). Ne u kući ni u blizini kuće.

Match each message with one of the statements (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.

Message 2

rights: D — Do you want to go out with me?

pairs.l: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
pairs.r: D — Do you want to go out with me?

pairs.l: Message 4
Message 5

qs.exp: 1=E (no hurry = take your time), 2=F (what’s the schedule? = we need to meet), 3=D (go together = do you want to go out?), 4=A (where have you been? = I’m worried), 5=C (you didn’t come = where were you?). B je suvišno.

qs.q: Why did Hannah go to town?
qs.exp: Hannah je išla u kupovinu (“on my way to the shops”). Susret s Frankom i kino su bili spontani, ne planirani.

qs.q: Why is Ryan going away next weekend?
qs.exp: Ryan ide da bi se odmorio i proveo kvalitetno vrijeme s obitelji (“looking forward to some free time”) → relax. Rad nosi sa sobom, ali to nije razlog odlaska.

qs.q: What does Imogen think about Erin?
qs.exp: “She likes to tell you what to do” = bossy (ona zapovijediva). Imogen ima mješovite osjećaje, ali opisuje je kao bossy.

qs.q: What does Tyler think of the party?
qs.exp: Glazba je bila toliko glasna da su morali vikati → party je bio blačan/bukačan (noisy).

qs.q: Why did Maisie visit Sophia?
qs.exp: Maisie nije morala (Sophia je rekla “you have to” ali ona je sama odlučila). Otila je jer je mislila da je to ispravno (“the right thing to do”) → felt she should.

qs.q: How old is Adam Just?
qs.exp: Prema ispunjenoj knjižici: 16. Jeđino dijete u prostoriji, “only teen in the room”.

qs.q: What is Adam Just’s nationality?
qs.exp: Rođen u Kanadi → Canadian. Ispunjena knjižica: “Canadien”.

qs.q: Who is Adam Just’s music hero?
qs.exp: Adam kaže: “my idol... Dr Dre” → music hero = Dr Dre.

qs.q: What did Adam Just win a BRIT Award for?
qs.exp: Nominiran u tri kategorije, ali nagradu je dobio za International Album.

qs.q: What was Adam Just’s first No.1 single?
qs.exp: ‘Wild’ = prvi singl (br. 20), ‘Busted’ = treći singl i prvi koji je došao na vrh.

qs.q:
Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F). One letter is not needed.

16. When Destivelle was a young teenager, the family moved to France ___.
17. In 1992, she became the first woman ___.
18. In 1994, she climbed the southwest face of Shishapangma Mountain ___.
19. In 1996, she set another record ___.
20. Destivelle fell and broke her leg ___.
rights: A — to complete a solo ascent of the Eiger’s north face.
B — when she made the first ascent of Peak 41111 in Antarctica.
C — to study physiotherapy at the École de kinésithérapie de Paris.
D — where she attended the Lycée Corot in Savigny-sur-Orge.
F — while descending from the summit.

pairs.r: D — where she attended the Lycée Corot in Savigny-sur-Orge.
A — to complete a solo ascent of the Eiger’s north face.
B — when she made the first ascent of Peak 41111 in Antarctica.
F — while descending from the summit.

qs.exp: 16=D, 17=A, 18=E, 19=B, 20=F prema ključu. C (to study physiotherapy) je suvišno.

qs.q: I said ‘Tell ___’ and he said he fancied me!
qs.exp: ‘Tell the truth’ = reci istinu. Fiksna fraza u engleskom.

qs.q: I don’t think he was lying – I think he’s an ___ guy.
qs.exp: ‘Honest’ = iskren, ne laže → odgovara kontekstu “I don’t think he was lying.”

qs.q: He’s a bit competitive – he wants to ___ better than the others in the class.
qs.exp: ‘Do better’ = biti bolji, postići više. ‘Do well/better’ je standardna kolokacija.

qs.q: Do you think he’ll ___ a good friend?
qs.exp: ‘Make a good friend’ = biti dobar prijatelj. ‘Make’ se koristi za opisivanje nečijih kvaliteta/uloga.

qs.q: Tell me what you think ___ I know what to do.
qs.exp: ‘So’ = kako bi, da. ‘Tell me... so I know’ = reci mi da znam što učiniti.

qs.q: Pharos was a small island ___ a tower was built from 280-247 BC to guide ships.
qs.exp: ‘Where’ = na kojoj (relativna zamjenica za mjesto). ‘A small island where a tower was built’.

qs.q: Fires burnt ___ night on top of the 117-metre-high structure.
qs.exp: Ispunjena knjižica: ‘at / all’. ‘Burn at night’ ili ‘all night’ — oba prihvatljiva.

qs.q: The light from the lighthouse ___ be seen 47km away.
qs.exp: Prošlost + mogućnost → ‘could be seen’ (pasivna forma s modalom could).

qs.q: Legends say ___ mirrors managed to burn enemy ships before they reached shore.
qs.exp: ‘Its mirrors’ = zrcala tog svjetionika (posvojna zamjenica za Pharos).

qs.q: ...today it is possible to ___ diving and see the ruins under the sea.
qs.exp: ‘Go diving’ = ici roniti. Standardna kolokacija s go + gerund.

qs.q:
Write a reply to Elizabeth’s message. Answer ALL her questions. Write 40–60 words.

Elizabeth’s message:
“I really enjoy your emails. But I’d like to picture where you live. Can you describe your house/flat to me? What’s your favourite room and why? What’s the area like where you live?”

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor — treba odgovoriti na 3 pitanja: (1) opis kuće/stana, (2) omiljena soba i zašto, (3) opis kvarta/područja. Primjer: “Hi Elizabeth! I live in a flat on the 5th floor. It has three rooms. My favourite is the living room because it has a big window with a great view. The area is quiet and green, with a park nearby.”

qs.q: A man is talking to a receptionist in an office building. What is the man’s name?
qs.exp: Glasovni zapis: ime se izgovara kao „Pye“ — ne Bye ni Pie. Receptionist ponavlja za potvrdu.

qs.q: A man is talking to a friend about shopping. How much will he pay for parking?
qs.exp: Parking košta £1.10. Nije £2.20 ni besplatan — kratki razgovor o parkirnom automatu.

qs.q: Summer is talking to a friend about her trip to town. Where did she go?
qs.exp: Summer je išla u restoran (C). Ne u shopping centar ni kino.

qs.q: Diane is talking to Archie at school. What does Archie lend Diane?
qs.exp: Archie posuduje Diane knjigu (book). Ne DVD ni bilješke — razgovor u školi.

qs.q: You hear the weather forecast on the radio. What should you take with you tomorrow?
qs.exp: Prognoza: sutra kiša → ponesi kišobran (umbrella). Kaput i naočare nisu potrebni po prognozi.

qs.q: Megan decided to do skydiving because of:
qs.exp: Megan se odlučila za skydiving zbog prijatelja (a friend) koji je to već radio. Ne zbog filma ni dečka.

qs.q: Before her first jump, she felt:
qs.exp: Prije prvog skoka Megan se osjećala preplšeno (afraid). Nije bila smirena ni entuzijastična — strah je bio dominantni osjećaj.

qs.q: She jumped out of the aircraft at about:
qs.exp: Megan je skočila s otprilike 13.000 stopa visine. Nije 4.000 ni 30.000 stopa.

qs.q: She says skydiving is:
qs.exp: Megan kaže da je skydiving siguran sport (safe) uz pravilnu obuku. Ne opasan ni stresno.

qs.q: She has jumped:
qs.exp: Megan je skočila dva puta (twice). Nije jedanput ni tri puta.

qs.q: The Internet Room is:
qs.exp: Internet soba je popularna (popular). Nije samo za članove knjižnice ni besplatna.

qs.q: Users of the Physio Studio must:
qs.exp: Korisnici Physio Studija moraju imati Access Card (A). Nisu nužni medicinski nalazi ni dob iznad 60.

qs.q: Fitness classes are free for:
qs.exp: Fitness satovi su besplatni za Gold članove (A). Silver i Bronze članovi plaćaju.

qs.q: Participants in the ballroom dancing lessons need to have:
qs.exp: Za ballroom dancing potreban je partner (B). Iskustvo i energija nisu uvjet za prijavu.

qs.q: The café is next to:
qs.exp: Kafić se nalazi pored bazena (next to the pool). Nije pored fitness centra ni plesnog studija.

qs.exp: 1=E (jeans su OK → dress casually), 2=B (dođi na večeru → join us), 3=C (pročitaj priručnik → follow instructions), 4=A (tiho → speak quietly), 5=D (puno fotografija → take photos). F (Enjoy the party) je suvišno.

qs.q:
What does Brenda think about her homework task?

Email: "I've got a problem with my homework. I don't know what I have to do. I feel so stupid. If it's what I think it is, it's easy. But I need to know. Can you help me and explain what the teacher wants us to do?"
qs.exp: Brenda ne zna što točno treba napraviti (“I don’t know what I have to do”) → zbunjujuće (confusing). Kaže da bi bilo lako kad bi znala — dakle nije teško.

qs.q:
When is Melinda leaving for New York?

Email: "My flight to New York on Tuesday has been unexpectedly cancelled. I'm taking the Thursday flight because the only available seats on Wednesday are in first class, which is too expensive."
qs.exp: Let u utorak otkazan, srijeda je previše skupa (first class) → uzima let u četvrtak.

qs.q:
Which subject does Guy like best?

Email: "I've got my test results. I did best in Maths, which is amazing. I wasn't so good in Literature, which is my favourite subject."
qs.exp: Guy kaže: “Literature... is my favourite subject” — omiljeni predmet je književnost, iako nije najbolje prošao na testu.

qs.q:
Why is Martha going to Dublin?

Email: "I'm going to Dublin again. My cousin starts working soon and wants me to look after the twins. She wants to pay me, but I won't let her. I'm sure it'll be fun."
qs.exp: Martha ide čuvati blizance (look after the twins) → babysit. Neće uzeti novac, dakle ne ide zaraditi.

qs.q:
How does Michelle usually go home from the disco?

Email: "I had to walk home from the disco again last night! I missed the night bus again. Usually my dad comes for me when this happens, but this time he was away on business."
qs.exp: Kada propušti autobus, obično je tata doveze (“usually my dad comes for me”) → by car.

qs.q:
What is Mark Garrick’s profession?

"Mark decided to start his own band. He’s now a successful musician who writes all his songs."
qs.exp: Tekst jasno kaže: “He’s now a successful musician.”

qs.q:
Where was Mark Garrick born?

"He was brought up in the centre of Birmingham, where his family has always lived."
qs.exp: “He was brought up in the centre of Birmingham” → rodni grad je Birmingham.

qs.q:
What is Mark’s hobby?

"I often get home and I’m out in the garden with my shovel planting daffodils... but gardening is all I have time for."
qs.exp: Mark ima više interesa (slikanje, kiparstvo), ali jedino za što ima vremena je vrtlarstvo (gardening).

qs.q:
What pet does Mark have?

"I love animals, but... I decided on a cat. My neighbours often have to feed her when I work late."
qs.exp: Mark razmišljao o psu, ali odlučio se za mačku (“I decided on a cat”).

qs.q:
What is the title of Mark’s published album?

"'Green Man' was immediately a success, but I’m a bit worried about the new one."
qs.exp: ‘Green Man’ je već objavljen i bio je uspješan. ‘Green Love’ je novi (još u radu).

qs.q:
Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F). One letter is not needed.

16. Most people are aware ___.
17. The queen bee is the most important bee, ___.
18. Drones are males ___.
19. Humans use this valuable beeswax ___.
20. Worker bees also go from flower to flower ___.
rights: A — whose only job is to fly out and mate with the queen
B — to produce candles, cosmetics and other products
C — that they have three ‘sexes’: queens, drones and workers
D — who can lay thousands of eggs a day
E — that honey is very healthy for humans
F — to collect nectar for honey

pairs.r: C — that they have three ‘sexes’: queens, drones and workers
D — who can lay thousands of eggs a day
A — whose only job is to fly out and mate with the queen
B — to produce candles, cosmetics and other products
F — to collect nectar for honey

qs.exp: 16=C, 17=D, 18=A, 19=B, 20=F prema ključu. E (honey is healthy) je suvišno.

qs.q: Don’t be afraid to ask questions at the interview. This is your opportunity to find out about the ___ as well as their opportunity to find out about you.
qs.exp: ‘Find out about the company’ — intervju je i prilika da saznaš više o tvrtki. ‘Job’ i ‘work’ ne odgovaraju kolokacijski.

qs.q: Pay attention to your ___. Dress professionally – neat and tidy. Avoid extreme hairstyles or colours.
qs.exp: ‘Appearance’ obuhvaća cijeli vanjski izgled (odijevanje, frizura, šminka) — najopćenitiji pojam koji odgovara svim savjetima koji slijede.

qs.q: Arrive fifteen minutes before the interview time. Don’t show up half an hour ___, but don’t rush in at the last minute.
qs.exp: Stigni 15 minuta ranije, ali ne pola sata ___ → ‘early’ (prerano). ‘Late’ bi značilo kasno — ali sljedeća rečenica govori o kasnom dolasku odvojeno.

qs.q: It’s essential to be ___ during the interview. Shake your interviewer’s hand. Don’t sit until you are invited to. Sit properly. Don’t use slang or swear.
qs.exp: Svi primjeri (rukovanje, ne sjedati dok nisi pozvan, ne koristiti sleng) opisuju ljubaznost/pristojnost → ‘polite’.

qs.q: Make a lot of ___ to show honesty and confidence – but remember it’s rude to stare.
qs.exp: ‘Eye contact’ pokazuje iskrenost i samopouzdanje, ali buljiš ako previše gledaš — savršeno odgovara kontekstu.

qs.q:
___ you ever seen one? Do you know how it works?

(Greenhouse text)
qs.exp: Present perfect question → ‘Have you ever seen one?’

qs.q: Greenhouses ___ used for growing various flowers, vegetables and fruits.
qs.exp: Passive present simple (množina) → ‘are used’.

qs.q: They look ___ a small glass house.
qs.exp: ‘Look like’ = izgledati kao. Fiksna fraza.

qs.q: Its glass walls let the sunrays in but keep them ___ going out.
qs.exp: ‘Keep something from doing’ = spriječiti nešto. ‘Keep them from going out’ = ne pusti ih van.

qs.q: This causes the greenhouse ___ heat up and keep the plants warm.
qs.exp: ‘Cause something to do’ = uzrokovati da nešto učini. ‘Causes the greenhouse to heat up’.

qs.q:
Write a reply to Sandra’s message. Answer ALL her questions. Write 40–60 words.

Sandra’s message:
“Tell me about the place where you live. How big is it? What do you like about it? Where do young people go in the evenings there?”

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor — treba odgovoriti na 3 pitanja: (1) veličina mjesta, (2) što voliš u njemu, (3) kamo mladi idu navečer. Primjer: “Hi Sandra! I live in Zagreb, a big city with about 800,000 people. I love the parks and cafes. In the evenings, young people usually go to the city centre, cinemas or clubs. It’s very lively!”

2010_ljeto.label: Ljetni rok
2010_ljeto.readingNote: Reading & Writing dio ovog ispita trenutno nije dostupan u simulatoru.

qs.q:
You hear 5 mobile phone messages. What is the main message of each speaker?
Match each message with one of the statements (A–F). One letter is not needed.
items: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
Message 5

pairs.l: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
Message 5

qs.exp: 1=D (railway station nearby → take the train), 2=E (Internet café → email me), 3=C (thanks for notes), 4=F (don’t get up → stay in bed), 5=B (cold in mountains → bring warm clothes). A (Come to the hotel) je suvišno.

qs.q: A woman is talking to a receptionist. What’s her name?
qs.exp: Iz transkripta: “It’s Frean. F-R-E-A-N.” → Ms. Frean.

qs.q: Two people are talking in a supermarket. What are they going to buy?
qs.exp: Imaju ribu i povrće kod kuće. Trebaju kupiti desert → banane (voće/fruit) za banana cake.

qs.q: Two friends are talking in the street. What bus will they take?
qs.exp: Broj 68 je dnevni autobus. Treba im noćni → Number 16.

qs.q: Two friends are talking in front of their school. Where are they going?
qs.exp: Muzej je otvoren do 22h četvrtkom, a danas je četvrtak → idu u muzej.

qs.q: A man is talking to a hotel receptionist. How much will his stay cost him?
qs.exp: Jedna noć = £75 (bez popusta za više noći). Odbio doručak → ukupno £75.

qs.q: Nancy will go on the trip…
qs.exp: Nancy ide na seminar o marketingu zbog posla (“My boss wants me to get some new ideas”).

qs.q: She will leave on…
qs.exp: Seminar je u petak, Nancy želi stići dan ranije → odlazi u četvrtak.

qs.q: She will stay in a hotel for…
qs.exp: Nancy je van 3 noći ukupno — hotel prve dvije, treću kod prijateljice → hotel = 2 noći.

qs.q: Her hotel is…
qs.exp: Hotel je conference centre next to the airport (“next to the airport”).

qs.q: The hotel will cost her…
qs.exp: “The company is paying for it, so it won’t cost me anything.” → nothing.

qs.q: The City Market is in…
qs.exp: Tur-vodič: “We want to go to Park Street, where the market is.”

qs.q: They will go to the market…
qs.exp: Duga šetnja + problemi s autobusom → “we’ll take the tube.”

qs.q: The market is well-known for selling…
qs.exp: Nekad jeftini suveniri, danas “famous for the designer label clothing.”

qs.q: The tour guide recommends having…
qs.exp: “You must try the strawberry ice-cream at Giorgio’s. It’s fantastic!”

qs.q: The shops close at…
qs.exp: “The shops close at half past six.” = 6:30 p.m.

qs.q:
Read the messages. What is the main idea of each message?
Match each message with one of the statements (A–F). There is one letter you do not need.

1. I wonder what I should do to make up with Mark? We had an awful fight yesterday.
2. Mum, can you call the dentist and ask if he can see me after school? I’ve got a terrible toothache!
3. Are you free tonight? Ring Peter and me up so we can make plans for this evening.
4. The kitchen’s a mess. Can you wash the dishes and put them away before I return from work? Thanks.
5. I’ll be at Sam’s Café at 9 tonight. I can’t wait to see you!
items: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
Message 5

pairs.l: Message 1
Message 2
Message 3
Message 4
Message 5

qs.exp: Primjer (0)=G. 1=E (daj mi savjet), 2=A (nazovi zubara), 3=F (nazovi nas), 4=C (počisti), 5=B (nađimo se).

qs.q: What does Don want Clive to do?
opts: To do his homework with him.
qs.exp: Don pita: ‘Can I borrow yours?’ — želi posuditi bilješke (notes).

qs.q: How did Kimberley feel about making the cake?
qs.exp: ‘it was complicated’ = teško. Nije bilo dosadno (ona je bila ta koja se dosadila), a nije ni ugodnô jer je rezultat bio kaotican.

qs.q: Why is Philip travelling to Japan?
qs.exp: Philip ide ‘relax and do sightseeing’ — odmor. Biznis je već postavljen prošle godine.

qs.q: What time does the gallery close?
qs.exp: ‘the gallery stays open till eleven’ — galerija je otvorena do 23:00.

qs.q: Who usually takes Ian to school?
qs.exp: Sutra je iznimka (mama vozi tetu). Inace mama vozi Iana — ona bi vozila da nema obaveze.

qs.q: What is Ann Morris’s current profession?
qs.exp: Ann je prešla s modelinga na glumu — actor/actress.

qs.q: Where was Ann Morris born?
qs.exp: Tekst jasno navodi: ‘Ann is from Oregon’.

qs.q: What was Ann’s favourite school subject?
qs.exp: ‘preferred playing with numbers’ → maths/math bila omiljena.

qs.q: What is Ann’s hobby?
qs.exp: Ann izričito kaže da ide hiking u slobodno vrijeme.

qs.q: What was Ann’s first job?
qs.exp: Ann je radila za Revlon i Pepsi — modelling/modeling je bio prvi posao.

qs.q:
Complete the sentences with the correct endings (A–F).
One letter is not needed.

16. This is why their school is a happier place ___.
17. You first have to teach a test class ___.
18. If they need more information about your work, ___.
19. The students interviewed Martha Bidden, ___.
20. Students say that they like teachers ___.
rights: A — when teachers can sometimes be strict
B — who are strict but have a sense of humour
C — and the students are more successful
D — who is now an English teacher at the school
E — students can ask you questions
F — while other students watch your performance

pairs.r: C — and the students are more successful
F — while other students watch your performance
E — students can ask you questions
D — who is now an English teacher at the school
B — who are strict but have a sense of humour

qs.exp: 16=C, 17=F, 18=E, 19=D, 20=B prema ključu.

qs.q: On a clear day, the view from the top is ___, and you can walk there and back in around eight hours.
qs.exp: ‘Terrific’ = veličanstven/odličan. Kontekst je pozitivan (lijepo vrijeme, preporuka).

qs.q: This is a very popular walk, so you will not be ___.
qs.exp: Popularna šetnja → nećeš biti sam (alone).

qs.q: But if the weather is bad, it can be ___, so don’t try it without a survival bag and a first aid kit.
qs.exp: Survival bag + first aid kit → opasno (dangerous).

qs.q: ...you don’t want to get ___, so carry a backpack with water, chocolate, and fruit like bananas.
qs.exp: Rješenje je ponijeti hranu i vodu → ne želiš biti gladan (hungry).

qs.q: Even on a good day, make sure you take ___ clothes with you, because it can get very cold at the top.
qs.exp: Na vrhu je hladno → tople (warm) odjevne predmete.

qs.q: Horseshoes ___ made of iron and the strength of iron can protect you from evil.
qs.exp: Horseshoes (množina) + present simple → 'are made of iron'.

qs.q: ...the strength of iron can protect you ___ evil.
qs.exp: 'Protect someone FROM something' — fiksna prepozicija.

qs.q: The position ___ the horseshoe is also very important.
qs.exp: 'The position OF something' — genitivna konstrukcija s 'of'.

qs.q: It must point up like a cup so that luck cannot fall ___ of it.
qs.exp: 'Fall OUT of' — phrasal verb koji znači ispasti/isteći iz nečega.

qs.q: Do you have ___ own lucky horseshoe?
qs.exp: Pitanje se obraća čitatelju → 'your own'.

qs.q:
Write a reply to Sandra’s message. Answer ALL her questions. Write 40–60 words.

Sandra’s message:
“Hi! Thanks for inviting me to your party. What’s the party for? What do you want me to bring? How do I get to your house? See you Saturday, Sandra”

sol.ans: Referentni odgovor — treba odgovoriti na sva 3 pitanja: (1) razlog zabave, (2) što donijeti, (3) kako doći do kuće. Primjer: 'Hi Sandra! I’m having a birthday party. Please bring some drinks. Take bus no. 5 to Oak Street, then turn left. My house is number 12. See you Saturday!'
